ci cacid+ngha ri cikloshā dzi/ tshowaṃ/9lo9 cho / skotsho snyeṭ+wāṃ3sna sgyu chi4sna pyecichidīskesto — sduci—rtseci tram̐ rnosnarda ram̐/ ste— sgro —rdzo — 〉 ju —ci /trīnā tsho ri tsho ru ci ri bye ru dzāri — sne sbyo wa ji wa 3k+ta rdzo ci ci ri ste cho jisno bye ri ci ci 4 ci— d+ku4ri tsho hūṃ (shā mi tsho༈ 7 / : ( hūṃ tsho —9 watshotsho dze jiX —ske k+ṣe / 4 / ram̐ ñca rngo —ga spya snyelha tsaṭ+wāṃca— rmici ṭā tsā tsho 5rngo risko smi— chi—dz+wa —prer+ha tsho ci — rme ci ji ci gyi na ca3 —— —byesgo tsho ri nici ci tho sa gra sa pa la ma — —wasnged+ngha— ts+tsha

dpe skrun gsal bshad/phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i khyab bdag bka' drin mtshungs med thugs rje'i gter mdzod rje btsun bla ma rin po che mtshan brjod par dka' ba don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi grags pa dpal bzang po mchog gi zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i gsung rab rnams las/ 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i 'grel pa dang /sa lam gyi rnam bzhag sogs rin thang gzhal du med pa'i gsung rab dpe cha khag gcig dus 'gyur skabs gzhan rkyen dbang gis mi mngon pa'i dbyings su thim/ gzhan lhag yod kyi gsung rab rnams skyabs rje gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog nas dpe skrun byed dgos pa'i bka' gsung dri ma med pa spyi bor son pa dang / bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu zhal slob rnams kyis yang yang dad rten du bskul ba'i phyir/ da lan dge 'dun nyi shu'i rnam par dpyad pa thar lam them skas dang / sgrol ma'i 'grel pa ut+pal sngon po'i do shal/ yum ka bde chen rgyal mo'i 'bru 'grel dang / chos rje dam pa nyid kyi rnam thar rgyas bsdus gnyis bcas par skrun du byas pa lags na/ rang nus ci lcogs kyis zhu dag byed khul byas kyang / da dung nor skyon gang mang mchis srid 1

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtsom / pas mkhyen ldan klog pa po rnams kyis lhag bsam zol med kyis dag bcos yo bsrang gnang bar 'tshal /zhes deb 'di'i 'gan 'dzin pa pad+ma theg mchog blo ldan du 'bod pas spyi lo2005zla 5 tshes 10nyin spos ngad ldan pa'i grong khyer rang gnas dga' tshal du bris pa dge/

dkar chagadape skrun gsal bshad/ (1)sde tshan dang po/ rnam thar gyi skor/dang po/ 7 chos rje dam pa mkhan rin po che dharma kin+ti'i rnam par thar pa ma bcos lhug pa'i rtogs brjod rdzogs ldan dpyid kyi dpal yon zhes bya ba bzhunigs so/ / mkhan bsod nams nyi mas brtsams (3)sa bcad dang po/ dgos pa rgyu mtshan brjod pa'i sgo nas gleng bslang ba/ (6)sa bcad gnyis pa/ rnam thar dngos bshad pa/ (10)dang po/ sku bltams pa dang sku na phra mo'i dus kyi mdzad pa mdor bsdus bshad pa/ (11)gnyis pa/ 'phral du dam pa'i rigs sad de rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rim bzhin bslab tshul bshad pa/ (17)1 theg pa chen po'i rigs sad pa'i mtshan ma khyad par can mngon du gyur tshul bshad pa/ (18)2 nges 'byung gi bsam pas thugs rgyud bskul nas khyim nas mngon par byung ste sku rab tu byung ba'i tshul bstan pa/ (21)3 grwa sar phebs nas thos bsam sgom gsum la sbyangs te legs bshad smin grol nyams su myong ba'i tshul bstan pa/ (26)1

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / (1)rgya che ba phar phyin theg pa'i gzhung bka' pod lnga sogs la sbyangs pa yun du mdzad tshul bstan pa/ (27)(2)zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol gyi gdams pa nyams su myong ba'i tshul bshad pa/ (29)(3)yang zab gsang ba bla na med pa'i man ngag rnams gsan bsam thugs nyams su bstar bar bshad pa/ (30)gsum pa/ mthar mkhas dang grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs te bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul bstan pa/ (35)1 mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsam gyi sgo nas ris med rgyal ba'i ༄bstan pa mi nyams gong 'phel du mdzad pa'i skor/ (35)2 grub pa'i go 'phang brnyes pa'i lag rjes lha dang bla mas lung bstan pa sogs khyad par gyi mdzad pa 'ga' zhig brjod pa'i skor/ (42)3 bshad sgrub las gsum gyi 'khor lo chen po rnam gsum phyag tu bstar te legs mdzad snang ba dam pa'i 'phrin las khyab brdal du spel ba'i skor/ (53)sa bcad gsum pa/ dge rtsa bla med byang chub tu bsngo zhing smon lam gyis rgyas gdab cing bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis mtha' brgyan pa/ (68)gnyis pa/ mi nyag mkhan chen thub bstan chos kyi grags pa'i rnam thar snying bsdus gsal ba'i me long thub bstan chos dar kyis brtsams (75)dang po/rigs rus dang sku 'khrungs pa'i dus/ (76)gnyis pa/byis pa'i dus kyi mdzad spyod/ (77)gsum pa/skyes chen rnams kyis sprul sku'i mtshan gsol tshul/ (80)2

da ka ra chag bzhi pa/sdom pa gsum gyi rgyun bzhes tshul/ (82)lnga pa/grwa sar byon nas thos bsam dang dbang lung bzhes tshul/ (84)drug pa/'chad nyan gyi sgo nas bstan pa spel tshul/ (88)1 'khor gdong dang g.yu khog dgon du byon pa'i skor/ (88)2 dus 'gyur gyi skabs/ (90)3 sman par bskos pa'i skabs/ (93)4 nang skor mdor chos sgar btab pa'i skabs/ (94)5 dpal rin chen thang la gdan sa mdzad pa'i skabs/ (95)6 sgrub grwa btab pa'i skor/ (100)7 'chad nyan gtso bo gang la mdzad pa'i skor/ (101)8 sdom pa gsum gyi rgyun spel ba'i skor/ (103)9 dgon sde ris med nas slob ma byung tshul gyi skor/ (104)10 mkhan po'i mtshan gsol ba'i skor/ (105)bdun pa/dgon sde dang slob grwar phebs nas bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul/ (106)1 khog tha sang sang dgon du byon pa'i skor/ (106)2 rgyal rong mtshams gnas dgon du byon pa'i skor/ (109)3 si khron zhing chen bod yig slob grwar byon pa'i skor/ (113)4 si khron zhing chen bod brgyud nang bstan slob grwar byon pa'i skor/ (114)5 nyag rong rdzong glag brag rdzong dgon par byon pa'i skor/ (114)6 rdzogs chen shrī seng bshad grwar byon pa'i skor/ (115)7 pe cin bod brgyud nang bstan slob grwar byon pa'i skor/ (116)3

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / 'i8 li thang mi 'gyur dgon par byon pa skor/ (117)brgyad pa/sgrub pa nyams len dang 'dus byas kyi dge rtsa bsags pa'i skor/ (118)1 spyi lo 2000skabs tshogs mchod kyi skor/ (120)dgu pa/ljags rtsom gyi bstan bcos skor/ (122)bcu pa/gsang ba'i rnam thar skor/ (123)sde tshan gnyis pa/ brtsams chos kyi skor/gcig dge 'dun nyi shu'i rnam par dpyad pa thar lam them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs/ (131)gnyis/ sgrol ma'i 'grel ba ut+pal sngon po'i do shal bzhugs so/ (173)gsum/ rdzogs pa chen po rig 'dzin nang sgrub kyi cho ga yum ka bde chen rgyal mo'i sgrub gzhung gi 'bru 'grel pilco ri ka'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (189)thor bu'i skor/ (344)1 gsol 'debs dad pa'i sgra dbyangs/ (344)2 tshig gsum nyams dga'i smon lam/ (344)3 chos skyong gsol mchod nyung bsdus/ (345)'gyuzhabs brtan gsol 'debs kyi skor/ (346)

mkhan chen chos kyi grag sa pa'i rtogs ba rjo da/ r+yā/ /chos rje dam pa mkhan rin po che darma kin+ti'i zi snye lhab/harnam par thar pa ma bcos lhug pa'i rtogs brjod rdzogs ldan dpyid kyi dpal yon zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /—grub chen mkhan po bsod nams nyi mas brtsams/na mo twa badz+ra sa tā ya/'phags yul skal ldan shing rta'i chu bo'i 'gram/ /bkra shis lim+bu ni yi tshal yangs su/ /shākya'i rigs su mtshan dpe'i pad+mo bzhad/ /rnam 'dren bu ram shing des shis pa stsol/ /dhu ma tha lar rig 'dzin bye ba'i mgon/ /gsang sngags snga 'gyur bstan pa'i 'khor los sgyur/ /grub brgya'i dbang phyug pad+ma saṃ bha wa/ /tshe rabs kun tu gtan gyi skyabs su bsten/ /rgyal kun ma.o pa'i rang gzugs chu zla'i gar/ /bcu drug lang tsho'i sgeg 'chang gzhon nu'i tshul/ /dmar ser nyi ma 'char ka'i mdangs bkra ba/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes lhag pa'i lha des skyongs/ /3

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtog sa ba rjo da dang gsung rtso ma / srid zhi'i mdzes sdug yongs kyi za ma tog /mthong bas yid 'phrog zla gzhon 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /snyan 'gyur bye ba'i gdangs ldan mkhyen pa'i gter/ /tshangs sras dpal mos bdag mgrin byin chen stsol/ /rab 'byams sras bcas rgyal ba'i phrin las dpal/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi gnyen gcig pu/ /rgyal yum 'phags ma'i thugs rje'i 'od snang gis/ /phun tshogs dge legs 'dzad med char du snyil/ /mkhyen brtse'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa'i khang pa las/ /dri med legs bshad dbyar rnga'i rol mo 'bam/ /༄bgrang yas skal bzang rna ba'i bcud len du/ /snyan par 'khrol mkhas chos rje bla mar gus/ /gang gi gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul rol ba yi/ /yon tan kun gsal yangs pa'i rjes 'gro bas/ /ji bzhin brjod pa thub rnam mkhyen pa'i yul/ /'ching ba kun ldan bdag 'dras ga la 'os/ /de lta na'ang dam pas nan gyi bka'/ /zlog tu ma bzod rje 'di'i thun mong gi/ /mdzad pa'i cha shas tsa ma zhig gleng ba yi/ /ma bcos lhug pa'i rtogs brjod spel bar bya/ /4

mkhan chen chos kyi grag sa pa 'i rtogs brjod/ de ltar shis brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis nye bar drangs te/ gang gleng bar bya ba ni/ dus mthar rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan gyen du 'degs shing bka' dang dgongs 'grel sogs mdo sngags rgyud sde gtsug lag dang bcas pa'i dgongs don la mkhyen rab kyi rtsal rdzogs te rang gzhan grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa/ lhar bcas 'jig rten kun gyi ma 'dres pa'i snying gi mdza' bor gyur cing ris su ma chad pa'i rgyal bstan grub mtha' yongs rdzogs kyi bshad sgrub chos kyi 'khor lo phyag tu bsnams pa'i thugs bskyed dang smon lam gyi mthu mngon du gyur pa/ dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje stsol med du mnga' ba'i bdag nyid chen po la don gyi slad du mtshan dngos su brjod na thub bstan chos kyi grags pa zhes mtshan snyan gyi ba dan dkar po bsil ldan gangs ri'i mdzes ljongs kyi mtha' dbus kun tu mngon par g.yo ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po de nyid kyi gsang ba gsum gyi rnam par thar pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa zhib rgyas su 'god pa ni 'phags pa mchog gi spyod yul kho na las/skyes sbyang gnyis char nas yon tan gyi cha phra mo'ang mi ldan pa'i dman pa bdag lta bu'i skal bar ma gyar mod/ 'on kyang gdul bya thun mong lha)( 311 111 ༄༄ pa snang ngor ma sang rus su gyur pa'i phyi yi mdzad spyod rnams rags bsdus shig sgro skur dang bral zhing rang bzhin brjod pa'i ngag gi sbyor ba nyung ngu zhig gleng ba la/ thog mar dgos pa dang rgyu mtshan brjod 5

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjod dang ga su nga rtsom / pa'i sgo nas gleng bslang ba dang / bar du skabs su bab pa'i rnam par thar ba dngos bshad pa dang / mthar dge rtsa bla med byang chub tu bsngo zhing smon lam gyis rgyas gdab cing bkra shis pa'i tshigs sa bcad pa'i ༄dbyangs kyis mtha' brgyan pa dang sa bcad gsum gyi sgo nas brjod la/sa bcad dang po/ dgos pa dang rgyu mtshan brjod pa'i sgo nas gleng bslang ba/sangs rgyas gnyis pa dbyig gnyen zhabs kyis/ mdo don che ba nyid thos nas/ /nyan pa dang ni 'dzin pa la/ /nyan pa po ni gus byed pas/ /thog mar dgos pa brjod par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i nang mdzod la mnga' dbang 'byor ba'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyi skyes pa'i rabs las brtsams te legs par bshad pa'i gtam gyi phreng ba spel ba ni dgos pa mchog dang ldan par mthong ste/ ji skad du/ de lta mod kyi tshu rol mthong ba'i blo/ /yun ring goms pa'i las nyon gyis bslad pas/ /dam pa'i yon tan mthong ba'i phongs gyur te/ /nor bu mching bur 'dzin pa'i blo can mang / /de sogs log shes dri ma 'khrud pa'i phyir/ /dag byed rnam thar gtsang ma lha yi chab/ /drang por gleng ba'i 'bab stegs la gzhol te/ /dad pa'i bzhin ras gsal phyir bkye ba'ang rigs/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin 6

mkhan chen chos kyi gra ga sa pa 'i rto gas ba rjo da/ dam pa rnams la gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan tshad med pa mnga' ba dag sngon du ma mthong ba rnams la gsar du rtogs par bya ba dang /rtogs zin dag la'ang dad mos gong 'phel du bskyed pa'i thabs su 'gyur zhing / gal te log par rtog pas rgyud bslad pa yin yang slar yang dad pa'i nor gyis 'byor bar 'gyur ba sogs dgos pa khyad par ba mang du mchis la/ spyir dam pa rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan spyi dang / khyad par sku tshe 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po cher thos bsam sgom gsum gyi tshul la mchog tu gzhol ba sogs mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan phul du phyin pa ni dam pa'i rnam thar gyi snying por snang ste/ de gang zhe na/ 'jam mgon mi pham rin po ches/thos bsam sgom pa las byung ba'i yang dag pa'i chos kyi snang ba thob pas mkhas shing / chos bzhin bskyed pa bslab pa gsum gyi yon tan dang ldan pas btsun pa/ bstan 'gror phan pa bzang po'i phrin las dang ldan pa/ mkhas pa rnams kyi tshul ni mdor bsdu na/ bshad sgrub las gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi 'khor lo gsum dang ldan pa yin la/zhes dang / 'brug rgyal dbang chos rjes kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa la thos pa dang / bsam pa dang / sgom pa rnam par dag pa mdzad pa'i tshul dang / de la brten nas mkhas pa'i yon tan 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ btsun pa'i yon tan sdom pa gsum gyi bcas pa'i mtshams las mi 'da' ba/ grub pa'i yon tan sa lam gyi rtogs pa khyad par 7

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjod dang ga su nga rtso ma / can thugs rgyud la 'khrungs tshul/ bzang po'i yon tan mkhas grub kyi lag rjes bstan pa dang 'gro ba yongs la sman pa'i phrin las rlabs po che ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul zhes sogs gsungs pa bzhin rang don du thos bsam sgom gsum/ gzhan don du 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ gnyis don du bshad sgrub las gsum ste mkhas pa'i tshul dgu'i yon tan gyis thugs rgyud phyug cing / bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len la rtse gcig tu gzhol bar mdzad pa nyid dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rnams kyi rnam thar dngos gtsang kho nar nges te/ de las gzhan du yab mes rigs rus kyi che ba/ mtshan snyan gyi grags pa 'bar tshul/ grwa 'khor gyi gzi byin rgyas tshul/ gnas skor dang rten gsum la mjal phyag mdzad tshul/ sa cha 'di nas 'dir phebs 'dir bzhugs/ 'du 'khor dang gdul bya mang po la mjal kha gnang tshul/ de dag gis zhabs tog dang brgya 'bul stong 'bul gyi rnyed pa thob tshul/ dgra dang gdon bgegs sogs la stobs dang rigs sngags sogs kyis tshar bcad tshul/ grwa 'khor dang gdul bya mang po thabs kyis bskyangs tshul/rten bzhengs sogs dge ba ltar snang phran tsam byas pa'i tshul sogs la che brjod dang gcam bu'i zol bstod kyis sgro skur sna tshogs bcas kun sbyor gyi dri mas sbag pa'i tshig gi phreng ba la rab btags kyis brgyan te snyan tshig bcad lhug mang po spel ba ni sngon rabs gleng ba'i lo rgyus kyi gtam rgyud bshad pa'i gras yin gyis dam pa'i rnam thar gyi mtshan nyid 8

mkhan chen chos kyi grag sa pa 'i rto gas ba rjo da/ ci yang mi tshang ste/ rnam thar zhes pa'i sgra don ni sngon gyi mkhas pa dag gi gzhung las/ brjod bya dang rjod byed kyi rnam pa de la brten nas mthong thos kyi gdul bya rnams thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba zhig dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gong du bshad pa'i brjod bya mtha' dag tshang ba'i sgo nas rjod byed ngag rnam dag gi drang po'i tshig phreng spel ba na/ de nyid mthong ba dang thos pa'i gdul bya dman mchog gang yin yang rung ste dad gus bcos min rang shugs kyis rgyud la 'dren cing / bsod nams kyi tshogs rlabs po che tshegs med par gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / de la brten nas rjes 'jug skal bzang gi gdul bya rnams yongs 'dzin dam pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog de'i rnam thar gtsang ma'i rjes su bslabs te rang gi sgo gsam chos kyi lam las mi 'da' bar rim gyis ༄dam pa gong ma'i rjes zin te yon tan gyi tshogs tshad med pa mngon du gyur cing / mthar thug thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang mchog la gzhol bar 'gyur ba gdon mi za'o/ /de ni dam pa'i rnam thar bkod pa'i dgos pa dang nying dgos nyid du rigs par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/stobs bcu mnga' ba shākya seng ge yi/ /bla na med pa'i bstan pa rin chen mdzod/ /mi nyams gong du spel ba yongs kyi gtso/ /9

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtsom / mkhan chen bla ma chos kyi rgyal por 'dud/ /mgon po gang de'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi/ /phul byung yon tan 'gran zla bral ba'i tshul/ /deng gi dus 'dir kha ba'i yul ljongs su/ /chos kyi mtshan snyan kun la rlung ltar grags/ /gang gi mkhas btsun grub pa'i tshul 'di zhes/ /rtogs brjod ri mor 'bri ba'i ngal ba la/ /dgos pa don dang ldan te phyi rabs kyi/ /rjes su 'jug rnams dad pa 'phel ba'i slad/ /dam pa'i rnam thar gtsang ma drang po'i ngag /rab btags rgyan gyi shan la ma bsres par/ /rang bzhin brjod pa'i gtam gyi phreng ba 'di/ /gzar gnas skal bzang rnams la skyes su 'bul/ /༄zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /sa bcad gnyis pa/ rnam thar dngos bshad pa/da ni rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa skabs su bab pa'i rnam thar dngos bshad pa la gsum/ sku bltams pa dang sku na phra mo'i dus su mdzad pa mdor bsdus bshad pa/ 'phral du dam pa'i rigs sad de rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rim bzhin slob pa'i tshul cung zad spros te 10

mkhan chen chos kyi grag sa pa 'i rto gas ba rjod / bshad pa/ mthar mkhas pa dang grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs te bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rgya cher mdzad pa'o/ /dang po/ sku bltams pa dang sku na phra mo'i dus kyi mdzad pa mdor bsdus bstan pa/'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo'i ye shes kyis gzigs pa lhag par 'jug pa'i gnas kha ba'i rdul mang brtsegs pa'i sa 'dzin gyi phreng ba tshar du dngar ba'i ljongs bsil ldan bod kyi yul 'di la stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang drug ste gsum du gnas pa las/ phyi ma'i ya gyal mi nyag ra ba sgang du gtogs pa sa la dge bcu tshang ba/ yul la bkra shis mang ba/ sa gzhi thams cad bde la khod yangs pa spang ljongs dang me tog gi tshal bkra ba/ tshad pa'i ngad chung ba/ gdug pa'i srog chags nyung ba bya rigs sna tshogs kyis snyan pa'i sgra 'byin pa/ ri dwags kyi tshogs rnams bag pheb cing dal gyis rgyu ba sogs phyi rol yul gyi bkod pa 'od gsal lha la 'gran pa lta bu'i mdzes ljongs phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su shar bzhag bra lha rtse zhes/ gangs ri shel dkar gyi mchod sdong 'dra ba'i gnas mdun gyi nye zhol dgu 'brug sum mdo zhes bya ba'i gnas der yab yum chos ldan gtsang ma'i rigs su sku'i skye ba 'dzin par mdzad pa ste/ yab dge legs bya ba dang yum rtsa ra rdo rje bzang mo gnyis kyi 11

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtsom / rigs kyi myu gur son cing lhums su zhugs/ de yang ji skad du 'jig rten khams ni ji snyed par/ /chu yi snod ni thams cad du/ /bde gshegs nyi ma'i gzugs brnyan ni/ /dpag tu med pa cig car 'char /zhes dang / rje btsun byams pa'i rgyud bla mar yang / ji ltar be+e ḍūr+ya sa gzhi gtsang ma las/ /lha dbang lus kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro sems sa gzhi gtsang ma la/ /thab pa'i dbang po'i sku yi ༄gzugs brnyan snang / /zhes gsungs pa bzhin gdul bya dang phrin las kyi zhing gang ci snyed mchis pa de srid du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sa chen po la bzhugs pa rnams kyi sprul pa'i rol gar sna tshogs 'gag med du snang bar mdzad pa ni sras bcas rgyal ba'i rang gshis yin te/ mdo sde phal mo che las/ byang chub rgya mtsho rab brnyes gyur nas kyang / /sems can rgya mtsho rab tu smin byed phyir/ /byang chub sems bskyed rgya mtsho ston mdzad cing / /mi 'grib spyod pa rgya mtsho dus kun ston/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi rnam sprul de 'dra'o/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin du/ deng 'dir yang chos rje dam pa mkhan rin po che mchog gis bstan 'gro'i don du bsam bzhin mi yi srid pa ji ltar bzung ba yang / khong gi thugs bskyed dang smon lam rnam par dag pa mthu btsan po'i dbang gis dus kyi mtha' 'dir snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i phyir na rgyal bstan nub rir phyogs/ sems can dmu rgod kyis yul phyogs gang ba'i skabs su bab pa yin yang bstan 'gro'i rgud pa ya nga ba ches 12

mkhan chen chos kyi grag sa pa 'i rto gas ba rjo da/ mang ba la snying rje'i thugs kyis ma bzod nas snying stobs chen po'i go cha bgos te slar yang 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir ngur smrig gar gyi rnam rol du mtshan bzang gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor snang bar mdzad pa yin la/ de yang rab byung bco lnga pa'i bgrang bya lnga bcu pa legs sbyar du a nan+ta zhes pa bod kyi kun dga' ste 'byung rtsis pa'i me 'brug gi gnam lo'i spyi lo 1916'dzum zhal gyi dga' ston la rol ba'i nang tshan/ hor zla drug pa chu stod zla ba'i yar ngo tshes bcu'i nyi shar du ma yum la btsa' ba'i zug rngu phra mo yang med par/ mtshan dpe zla gzhon gyi dkyil 'khor mngal gyi pad mo'i cha 'dzin gyi sbubs las grol/ de'i ༄tshe ngo mtshar gyi mtshan ma yang mang du byung ste/ sku 'khrungs pa'i nyin de gar dpal ri ri bdun mtsho bdun zhes bya ba'i nang tshan mtsho shes brtan ma zer ba'i mtsho de'i nang nas 'brug bdun nam mkha'i dbyings su song ba dang bar snang thams cad 'ja' dang 'od kyis gur phub pa sogs dge mtshan du ma dbang po'i mngon sum du mthong bas thams cad ya mtshan/ gzhan yang sku bltams pa de'i nyin dar dkar po dri mas ma gos pa zhig gang byung ma nges par khyim du thon pa mthong zhing / chu zangs dkar gang yod pa de 'o mar gyur pa sogs ngo mtshar gyi gnas su gyur pa'i ltas mang du byung ngo / /sku nyid dgung grangs lnga drug tsam la nang skor nyi khug lung ba'i phu na brag ri zhig yod pa de'i nye 'gram du dgun khar nyin bzhin ra lug kha shas yod pa de'i rdzi bor 13

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtog sa brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / phebs tshe/ nyin gcig brag de ga'i rtsar phebs te brag de spyan lam du mthong ba'i rkyen byas/ dam chos 'dul ba dang mngon pa/ sher phyin sogs gzhung bka' pod lnga zer ba de brag ri 'di 'dra zhig yin ang snyam pa thugs la shar/ gzhan dpe cha mang po'i mtshan sna tshogs sa ler dran pa byung / 'phral 'phral du brag de dpe cha glegs bam gyi phon po dngos yin snyam pa'i thags snang rtsol med du shar ba'i rkyen gyis ༄brag de la dga' zhing dad pa'i mthus yang yang mjal du phyin/ rdzi grogs byis pa tshor tshul de gleng kyang brda gtan nas 'phrod mi dar gsungs/ de nas bzung rtsed mo'i skabs rnams su/ gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa dang / chos 'chad pa dang chos nyan pa dang / rdo sgam chung 'dra ba mang po brtsegs te bka' pod lnga 'di dang 'di'i glegs bam yin zhes gzhan sus kyang ma bslab bzhin du sku snga ma'i bag chags 'phral du sad pa'i mtshan ma mang po rdol thabs su byung ba'i mdzad pa mang du snang / rje 'di nyid sku gzhon nu nyid nas dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bdag gir bzhes pa'i tshul mang du mchis mod kyang zhib tshags gsal bor 'god rgyu ma rnyed la/ de'i tshul yang ji skad du/ du ba las ni me shes dang / /chu rkyar las ni chu shes dang / /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan gyi/ /rigs ni mtshan ma dag las shes/ /zhes gsungs pa nang bzhin byang sems chen po'i ngang tshul shugs 'byung gis 'byung ba dag gsang mi tshugs pa'i rigs sna tshogs mthun snang du mngon par 14

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rto gas ba rjo da/ srid pas/ sku byis pa phra na'ang tha mal pa'i kun spyod las 'phags pa'i sku'i rnam 'gyur gsung gi brjod stangs/ thugs kyi khyer so gang gi cha nas gzhan las ches khyad par du gyur pa smos kyis mi lang ba mnga' ba gdon mi za'o/ /de yang ji skad du kun gzigs lnga pa chen pos/mngal rgya'i brang 'gro'i mdud 'khrol dri bral sku'i/ /ma la yar skyes lcug phran gzhon nu dag /na tshod phra yang phan bde'i dri bsil ni/ /nam yang zad mi shes pa'i gter chen no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de nas rje nyid dgung grangs bdun bzhes pa tsam na mkhas pa'i dbang po mi nyag kun bsod mchog gi nye gnas bla ma a dpal zhes bya bas yi ge phyi mo'i klog sbyong gi thog ma'i brda sprod pa'i slob dpon mdzad/'di'i skabs su sku snga ma'i bla slob kyi 'brel ba dang chos dam tshig gtsang ma'i dbang gis gzhan las lhag pa'i thags shin tu brtse tshul ༄gyis thugs smon dang skyabs 'jug zab rgyas gnang / de'i rjes nas lo ngo gnyis tsam la dbul po'i byis pa yin phyir gzhan gyi bran g.yog dang phyugs rdzi'i zhor la klog sbyong phran bu re mdzad/ 'di skabs yas mas tsam nas khong la gsung gi gdangs shin tu snyan mo zhig mnga' bas gzhan dag gis glu gzhas dang / mgur ma gna' sgrung gi gtam rgyud sogs 'don du bcug nas kun gyis brngan pa phran tsam re ster ba dang grong chog re 'ga'i gral mjug zin tsam byung bas rnyed pa mi dman pa thob/ des ma rgan la 'tsho ba'i kha snon gyi bdag rkyen phran bu 15

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / 'bul thub pa'i go skabs byung zhes zhar 'phros su bstsal ba kho bos kyang thos/ dgung lo bcu par rang dgon hor tshang gi bla ma a khyug mchog nas lto gos sogs 'tsho chas bcas gnang sbyin bstsal nas klog 'don dang bca' 'bud rdung gsum sogs bslab pas tshegs med du mkhyen te dge rgan gyi thugs mnyes par gyur/ de rjes dgung grangs bcu gsum tsam la sleb skor/ mdo rin po che khams gsum zil gnon dgyes pa rdo rje brag mkhar dgon du phebs nas 'dus sde la/ kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung dang khrid yig ye shes bla ma sogs ljags khrid gnang ba'i skabs khong chos gral du zhugs/ de'i tshe bla mas ci gsungs thams cad ma yum sogs gzhan kun la gsal bar bshad pas bla grwa rgan pa rnams kyang ya mtshan nas 'di 'dra'i byis pa dbang rnon zhes bsngags pa'i yul du gyar/ mdo rin po ches sngon 'gro gsangs pa'i zla riri ༅ ri ri shas tsam gyi rjes la dad pas gsol ba btab pa'i rkyen gyis/ gsol ba gzims khang gi rtsigs ngor mdo rin po che dbu la paṇa zhwa gsol ba can zhig sku stod yan chad mngon sum du bzhugs pa lta bu bkra lam mer mjal gsungs/ de la sogs pa khong la lhan skyes kyi yon tan mnga' ba'i rnam thar shin tu mang ngo / /smras pa/ sku yi 'dab ldan phra mo'i dus nyid nas/ /tshul gnas thos dang kun bzang spyod pa yis/ /dam pa'i rnam thar la gnas 'jig rten gyi/ /16

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa 'i rto gas ba rjo da/ phal ba'i bya ba dag las ring du song / /khyed ni ring nas byang chub thags bskyed de/ /༄rgyal sras sems dpa'i lam gyi yon tan rdzogs/ /dus gsum kun tu ma bsgribs ye shes spyan/ /lhan skyes pad+ma'i dri bzhin khyod la mnga'/ /'di ni sngon byon rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras/ /dus 'dir mi yi zol la brten no zhes/ /dam pa rnams kyis lung gi me tog 'thor/ /lha klu mi gsum dga' ba'i ca co sgrogs/ /khyed sku dri bral zla gzhon 'dzum zer gyis/ /thub bstan ku mud mdangs ldan 'dab brgya bzhad/ /gangs ljongs bsod nams skyed tshal mdzes par byas/ /phan bde'i dge legs 'dzad med char du bsnyil/ /zhes bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gnyis pa/ 'phral du dam pa'i ri gas sad de rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rim bzhin bslab pa'i tshul cung zad spros te bshad pa/de la theg pa chen po'i rigs sad pa'i mtshan ma khyad par can mngon du gyur pa'i tshul dang / nges 'byung gi bsam pas thugs rgyud 17

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtog sa brjo da dang ga su nga rtsom / bskul te khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba'i tshul/ grwa sar phebs nas thos bsam sgom gsum la sbyangs te legs bshad smin grol gyi bdud rtsi nyams su myong ba'i tshul bcas gsum las/dang po theg pa chen po'i rigs sad pa'i mtshan ma khyad par can mngon du gyar pa'i tshul bshad pa la/ dbu ma la 'jug pa las/ so stoso'i skye bo'i dus na'ang stong pa nyid thos nas/ /nang du rab tu dga' ba yang dang yang du 'byung / /rab tu dga' ba las byung mchi mas mig brlan cing / /lus kyi ba spu ldang bar 'gyur ba gang yin pa/ /de la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas blo yi sa bon yod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar zab mo stong pa nyid kyi mtshan rna bar thos pa tsam gyis rab tu dga' zhing dad par gyur te lus kyi ba spu g.yo/ mig nas mchi ma dbang med du 'chor bas lus sems sdod mi tshugs pa lta bur 'byung bar gyur pa gang yin pa de la ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas blo yi sa bon yod ces theg pa chen po'i rigs sad pa'i rtags mtshan du dpal ldan zla bas 'jug pa rtsa 'grel sogs las gsal bar bshad pa bzhin/ chos rje dam pa 'di nyid kyang sku na shin tu gzhon pa'i dus skabs shig tu jo khu brag zhabs pa'i rgan mo zhig tshe dus byas par/ der gshin chog nyin gsum gyi gral mthar bzhugs pa'i tshe/ nyin zhig ja skabs shig na khri rgan bla ma rdo rje tshe ring zhu ba des/ khong gis sngon chad mkhan rin po che gzhan 18

mkhan chen chos kyi grag sa pa 'i rto gas ba rjo da/ phan chos kyi snang ba'i mdun nas dbu ma'i chos skor sogs la gsan sbyang mdzad pa'i tshul zhal brda mang tsam gsungs 'phral/ khong sku na gzhon pa'i stabs kyis rgyu mtshan ci yang mi shes mod 'on kyang dbu ma zhes pa'i mtshan rna lam du thos pa tsam gyis/ sku lus kyi ba spu g.yos shing spyan chab dbang med du shor te sdod mi tshugs pa lta bur gyar stoskabs bla grwa rgan po tshos kyang khong gis spyan chab shor ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin ma shes par ma gir grwa chung de don ci yang med bzhin ngu ba de 'dra rten 'brel la nye ngan pa zhig ma yin nam zer nas/ kun gyis 'phya smod dang tshig ngan gyis sma 'bebs sogs byas kyang / khong la sngon gyi bag chags dran pa'i stobs kyis bcos rgyu dang bzod thabs gzhi nas med pa zhig byung gsungs/ tshul de ni theg pa chen po mdo sde rgyan las kyang / sbyor ba'i sngon du snying rje dang / /mos pa dang ni bzod pa dang / /dge ba yang dag spyod pa ni/ /rigs kyi rtags su nges par bshad/ /ces sogs gsungs pa'i don dang shin tu mthun par snang ste/ 'jam mgon mi pham pa'i mdo rgyan 'grel par rigs kyi mtshan ma'am rtags ni shin tu mang yang mdor bsdus na/ gang zag gang la rtags bzhi bo de rnams yod pa de theg pa chen po'i rigs can yin par du bas me bzhin shes par byed de/ gang zhe na theg chen la sbyor ba'am 'jug pa'i sngon du zhes byang chub mchog tu sems ma bskyed pa'i sngon du yang gang zag de yis sems can sdug bsngal bar mthong 19

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / nas snying rje ngang gis skye ba dang / theg pa chen po zab cing rgya che ba'i chos thos pa tsam nas de'i don ma shes kyang rang bzhin gyis mos pa skye ba dang / gzhan don du dka' ba spyad pa rnams thos na yang 'di ga la nus snyam du mi zhum par de ngo mtshar re che snyam du sems kyis bzod pa dang / phar phyin drug gi dge ba rnams la'ang ngang gis spro zhing spyod par dga' ba ni/ theg pa chen po'i rigs kyi rtags su nges par bshad de rigs de dang mi ldan pa rnams ni de las ldog pa'i ngang tshul can yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas kyang nges so/ /gzhan rgyud bla ma las/theg mchog la mos sa bon shes rab ni/ /sangs rgyas chos skyed ma dang bsam gtan gyi/ /bde ba'i mngal gnas snying rje ma ma can/ /gang yin de dag thab pa'i rjes skyes sras/ /zhes theg chen lam la mos pa sogs ༄thub pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs sras byang chub sems dpar lung gis bsngags pa bzhin blo ldan rnams kyis rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /smras pa/ma la ya skyes ljon pa phra mor yang / /bsil ba'i ngad ldan dri bsung ngang gis khyab/ /de bzhin theg chen rigs kyi mtshan ma rnams/ /ma ma gtogs gzim srol med ces chos khrid kyi skabs rnams su khyod la thog ma nyid nas lhun gyis grub/ /sku yi lang tsho shin tu phra na yang / /20

mkhan chen chos kyi grag sa pa 'i rto gas ba rjod / rtogs pa'i yon tan rdzogs pa'i rgan po bzhin/ /rgyal sras tshogs kyi dbus na mdzes pa zhes/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur thob/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'od stong 'bar ba'i gzi/ /bsod nams rin chen gling du shar ba'i tshe/ /thub bstan pad+ma dkar po'i 'dab brgya grol/ /gangs ljongs phan bde'i skyed tshal mdzes par byas/ /e ma khyed ni snyigs dus bstan 'gro'i gnyen/ /lha gcig mar me mdzad dang gnyis su med/ /byang chub sems ldan kun bzang spyod pa yi/ /thabs mkhas mdzad pas don gnyis lhun gyis grub/ /ces skabs dbye ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gnyis pa nges 'byung gi bsam pas thags rgyud bskul te khyim nas ༄khyim med par rab tu byung ba'i tshul bstan pa la/de yang ji skad du/ btson ra 'dra ba'i khyim la ni/ /nam yang bde bar ma sems shig /phyug gam yang na dbul yang rung / /khyim na gnas pa nad du che/ /gcig ni srung bas nyon mongs la /21

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtog sa brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / gnyis pa 'tshol bas sha thang ngo / /zhes dang / gal te chos spyod khyim gyi so nam 'chor/ /khyim na gnas na chos kyang ga la 'grub/ /de bas chos dang 'gal ba'i skyon yod phyir/ /bdag la phan 'dod su zhig chags par byed/ /ces sogs gsungs pa ltar khyim la gnas pas ni gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi mi 'dod pa'i nye bar 'tshe ba mtha' dag 'dren par byed cing / thar ba'i lam gyi gegs su'ang 'gyur bas chos rnam dag sgrub pa'i gang zag gis dug bzhin spang dgos par gzigs shing / rab tu byung ba ni bde ba mi zad pa'i bsil khang mchog la gnas pa ste/ ji skad du/tshul khrims ldan pa sangs rgyas 'byung dang 'phrad/ /tshul khrims ldan pa rgyan rnams kun gyi mchog /tshul khrims ldan pa dri dang byug pa yin/ /tshul khrims ldan pa dga' ba kun gyi gnas/ /tshul khrims ldan pa gdung ba bsil ba'i chu/ /tshul khrims ldan pa 'jig rten kun gyis bstod/ /ces sogs tshul khrims yang dag par ldan pa'i mdo las rab tu byung ba'i tshul khrims la bsngags pa bzhin thags la nges shing /༄khyad par du/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs/ /zhes pa ltar 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan mtha' dag gi rten du'ang gal che bar dgongs te/ mdor na lha dang mi'i srid pa'i phun tshogs thams cad ni mkhris nad can la btso zan bzhin zhen pa gting nas log kun nyon 22

mkhan chen chos kyi gra ga sa pa 'i rto gas ba rjod / 'khor ba'i gnas 'di ni/ me 'bar ba'i 'obs dang srin mo'i gling lta bu/ sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin/ sdug bsngal gyi yo lang / sdug bsngal gyi 'phrul 'khor 'ba' zhig tu mthong nas de las gtan du thar 'dod kyi nges par 'byung ba'i bsam pas thugs rgyud la bskul te/ sngon dus su goms pa'i thugs kyi bag chags bzang po'i mthu las/ mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi rjes su zhugs pa la pad+ma'i mtsho ru ngang ba zhugs pa bzhin thugs shin tu spro ba dang bcas pas/dgung grangs bco lnga skor tsam la btsun pa bstan mkhas kyi yon tan mchog tu mnga' ba khri rgan bla ma rdo rje tshe ring nas mkhan po dang /dge bshes tshe ring rdo rje mchog gis las kyi slob dpon mdzad de kha skong gi dge 'dun bcas tshigs snga ma rab tu byung ba dge tshul gyi sdom pa yang dag par bzhes te mtshan thub bstan grags pa 'od zer gsol/de nas bzung dam chos 'dul ba'i bslab sdom phra mo'i gnas tshun chad la 'jug ldog tshul bzhin du mdzad de bstan pa'i mig rgyan du gyar////de //shādza ri ringa' skabs yas mas su 'a ra gdong sprul pa'i sku rin po che 'gyur med rdo rje mchog gis mchog sprul shes rab me 'bar zhes bya ba'i skyes bu dam pa de nyid kyi yang srid du ngos 'dzin gnang ste/ lha dang bla ma'i lung bstan 'khrul med du mnga' ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ bla brang gi gzims shags dang rta drel sogs sgar chas mchod cha bcas ba.a+yo nas/ khri 'don mdzad rtsis dang bstan pa'i khur bzhes dgos pa'i 23

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / bka' phab nan tan mdzad kyang / dus dbang gis bstan dgon gyi bya ba phal cher chos brgyad dang rnam g.yeng gi rgyur 'gyur zhing thos bsam sogs kyi gegs su'ang 'gro che bar dgongs te/ bstan srid kyi bdag po'i mtshan snyan gyi cod pan bdag gir ma mdzad do/ /gzhan yang sngon sku na phra mo'i skabs su ba gnas sku zhogs rin po che rnam gnyis nas/ ba lang dgon pa'i bla ma tsha nyag shes rab ces bya ba shin tu ngo mtshar can gyi bla ma zhig yod pa de'i yang sprul du ngos 'dzin gnang ste mtshan gsol/ yongs grags su chos rje dam pa 'di nyid ni khams kyi bla ma mkhas btsun bzang po'i rnam thar la mnga' dbang 'byor ba thub bstan chos kyi grags pa'am mi nyag kun bzang bsod nams zhes bya ba'i skyes bu dam pa de nyid kyi sprul sku yin par kun la grags shing grub pa yin no/ /bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa ni/ grwa sar phebs rjes dgung grangs nyi shu lhag tsam la shrī seng chos grwa chen por dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i sgo nas sdom pa yang dag par bzhes pa yin la/ de yang bkra shis pa'i gtsug lag khang de nyid du/ btsun pa brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i gnas brtan chen po bslab gsum nor ba'i mdzod mkhan chen pad+ma theg mchog blo ldan nam (yongs grags ༄su a bu lha dgongs )zhes bya bas mkhan po mdzad/ las kyi slob dpon ni mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan mchog tu mnga' ba'i mkhan chen gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po thub bstan snyan grags zhes bya 24

mkhan chen chos kyi grag sa pa 'i rto gas ba rjo da/ bas mdzad/ (thub snyan )gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon ni mkhas dang grub pa'i dbang phyug 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po mkhan chen 'jigs med yon tan mgon po zhes bya bas mdzad/ (mgon ris )dus go ba gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po mkhan chen pad+ma tshe dbang dang / kha skong ba mkhan po 'jigs blo sogs dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i sgo nas gsol bzhi'i las kyis bsnyen par rdzogs te dge slong gi dngos po rnam par dag pa thugs rgyud la bzhes par mdzad/ de nas dam pa'i chos 'dul ba las ji ltar bstan pa'i dgag sgrub kyi gnas phra rags ma lus par blang dor tshul bzhin mdzad pa'i sgo nas/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i thugs rgyud yon tan gyis mdzes shing spud pa'i mchog tu gyar te/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig ༄rten mtha' dag gi bsod nams kyi zhing yon gnas bla na med pa nyid du gyur to/ /smras pa/ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po yi/ /bstan pa'i nang mdzod so sor thar ba zhes/ /byang chub sems dang sngags kyi sdom pa yang /'di la ma brten skyes pa'i go skabs bral/ /de slad 'di ni rgyal bstan yongs kyi gzhi/ /'jig rten khams su rgyal ba'i bstan pa ni/ /25

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjod dang ga su nga rtsom / gnas dang mi gnas 'di la rag las pas/ /bstan pa'i rtsa ba dge slong yin zhes bsngags/ /khyod ni lhag pa'i bslab pa rin po che/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i dpal gyis mdzes/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten kun gyi yon gnas te/ /rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob dam pa nyid du nges/ /dus kyi mtha' 'dir gnas brtan ba ku la/ /sdom brtson ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gar mdzad de/ /mkhan chen chos kyi mtshan snyan grags 'bar ba/ /khyod ni nye ba 'khor dang gnyis su med/ /so thar byang sems rig pa 'dzin pa yi/ /phra mo'i nyes pa'i skyon gyis ma reg par/ /ma smad tshul khrims bslab pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /mgon khyod thub bstan mdzes pa'i rgyan du che/ /zhes ngal gso ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gsum pa grwa sar phebs nas thos bsam sgom gsum la sbyangs te legs bshad smin grol gyi bdud rtsi nyams sa myong ba'i tshul bstan pa la/༄rgya che ba phar phyin theg pa'i gzhung bka' pod lnga sogs la thos bsam gyi sgo nas sbyang pa yun du mdzad pa'i tshul dang / zab mo rdo rje theg 26

mkhan chen chos kyi grag sa pa 'i rto gas ba rjo da/ pa'i smin grol gyi gdams pa nyams su myong ba'i tshul/ yang zab gsang ba bla na med pa'i man ngag rnams gsan bsam thugs nyams su bstar ba'i tshul te gsum las/dang po/ rgya che ba phar phyin theg pa'i gzhung bkang pod lnga sogs la sbyangs pa yun du mdzad tshul bstan pa la/ ji skad du/ me tshogs spu gri'i so yang brgal nas kyang / /phyi mthar thug gi bar du dam chos btsal/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni lus dang srog la mi ltos par gzhan don dang chos phyir dka' ba spyad pa la mi 'jigs pa'i bzod pa thob pa yin pa'i phyir na/ rje nyid dgung grangs bco brgyad bzhes pa tsam na snga 'gyur gyi gdan sa chen po zhe rdzogs gnyis dang / koḥthog rdo rje gdan sogs bshad sgrub chos kyi dga' tshal chen po rnams su pad+ma'i tshal la bung ba'i sbrang rtsi 'tshol ba bzhin phyogs kun tu nyul bar mdzad do/ /thog mar shrī seng chos grwa chen po nas mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po thub bstan snyan grags mchog gi drung du rgyal sras lag len rtsa 'grel/ mkhas grub rje'i stong thun skal bzang mig 'byed/ sdom gsum rnam nges rtsa 'grel sogs gzhung tshan mang po la gsan sbyang nan tan lhur len mdzad/ mkhan ngag dbang nor bu las spyod 'jug mchan 'grel rgyas khrid dang / mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa mchims che chang gnyis mdzod kyi mchan snga phyi lan ༄gnyis lhag par mdzod kyi dka' 'grel mtha' dpyad sogs la zhib 27

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtog sa brjo da dang gsu nga rtsom / gsan byas te lan grangs du mar thugs brtson lhur bzhes mdzad nas/mngon pa gong 'og gi thun mong dang thun min gyi rtogs dka' ba'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhas par sbyangs te thos pa'i shes rab 'phel/mkhan gzhan dga'i sher phyin gyi mchan 'grel dang / dpal sprul rin po che'i sher phyin spyi don dang 'bru 'grel/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po'i 'grel chang don gsal sogs phar phyin skor la gsan sbyang rgya cher ༄mdzad/ mkhan rin po che mgon ris las kyang dpal sprul sher phyin spyi don sogs sher phyin gyi skor mang du gsan/ mkhan chen pad+ma tshe dbang las kun mkhyen go rams pa'i sher phyin spyi don sbas don zab mo gter gyi kha 'byed dang / mtha' dpyad yum don rab gsal/ sher phyin gyi dbu nas zhabs su bsdus pa'i mtshan nyid sbas don rab gsal/dge 'dun nyi shu'i rnam bzhag skyes bu mchog gi gsal byed/ rten 'brel gyi rnam bshad 'khor 'das rab gsal/ bsam gzugs kyi bshad pa snyom 'jug rab gsal/ chos 'khor gyi mtha' dpyad (mi nyag kun bsod gsungs )bcas sher phyin gyi skor rnams la thugs brtson cher bzhes mdzad pas phar phyin la mkhyen rab rgya che ba byung / mkhan bsod rgyal drung du dpal ldan zla ba'i 'jug pa rtsa 'grel sogs dbu ma'i bshad pa rgya cher gsan/ me ba mkhan po ye shes dar rgyas mchog gi sku drung du/ 'jam mgon mi pham pa'i dbu ma rgyan gyi rnam bshad 'jam dbyangs bla ma dgyes pa'i zhal lung dang / brag lan nyin byed 28

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa 'i rto gas ba rjo da/ snang ba/ rab lan rigs lam rab gsal de nyid snang byed sogs 'ju mi pham chen po'i gsung skor phal che ba'i bshad pa dang bklag lung sogs kyi rgyun gsan/ ngag dbang nor bu rin po che'i mdun nas bde chen zhing khrid sogs bklag lung gi rgyun mang du gsan/ mkhan chen pad+ma tshe dbang las/ lo hril bo gcig lhag tsam la 'jam mgon mi pham pas mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel gyi 'grel chen legs bshad snang ba'i gter zhes pa zhib rgyas su gsan cing gzhan tshad ma'i chos skor ci rigs par dpe gzigs dang dpyad pa rtsod pa'i rigs lam byang ba sogs brtson pas snga 'gyur gyi gdan sa chen po rnams su shes rab myur ba'i tshad du kun la grags pa byung ngo / /des ni mdo phyogs la sbyang brtson mdzad pa'i tshul mdo tsam brjod zin to/ /gnyis pa/ zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol gyi gdams pa nyams su myong ba'i tshul gleng ba la/ ru dam sgrub sde o rgyan bsam gtan chos gling du/ rdzogs chen yid bzhin nor bu sku phreng lnga pa thub bstan chos kyi rdo rje las/ zhi khro 'phrad tshad rang grol gyi dbang lung sogs chos bka' du ma'i bka' drin thob/ rdzogs sprul drug pa 'jigs bral byang chab rdo rje'i sku drung nas kyang / spyi 'dus tshe dbang sogs smin grol gyi ༄gdams pa gsan/ 'brug pa sku chen las/ bi ma'i gsang dbang snying thig dang pad+ma'i mkha' 'gro snying thig rgyal ba klong chen pa'i bla ma yang tig dang mkha' 'gro yang tig zab mo yang tig bcas snying thig ya 29

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma/ bzhi kha skong dang bcas pa'i dbang dang ljags lung bstsal ba gsan/gzhan yang rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling ba'i zab gter pod gnyis kyi dbang dang bklag lung bcas gsan/ rdzogs chen kong sprul rin po che nas/ snying thig rtsa gsum sogs zab gter glegs bam gnyis kyi dbang dang / gzhan snying thig gi chos skor du ma'i smin grol ljags lung bstsal ba rnams gsan/ mkhan rin po che mgon ris mdun nas skyabs mgon mkhyen brtse ye shes rdo rje'i dgongs gter 'dzin pa rang grol gyi khrid dang dbang bklag lung bcas bstsal ba gsan cing /gzhan chags med bcod kyi dbang lung sogs dbang lung gi rgyun chos mang po gsan/ yab rgan ngag dbang nor bu mchog nas/ rgyal ba klong chen pa'i yid bzhin mdzod rtsa 'grel/ gsang 'grel phyogs bcu'i man sel sogs man sel skor gsum/ smin gling lo chen gyi gsang snying ra no༅'grel ba gsang bdag dgongs rgyan dang de'i spyi don gsang bdag zhal lung sogs sngags phyogs kyi rgyud sde mang po'i khrid dang man ngag bklag lung bcas rgya cher gsan sbyang mdzad nas thugs la chub par mdzad do/ /gsum pa/ yang zab gsang ba bla na med pa'i man ngag rnams gsan bsam thugs nyams su bstar ba'i tshul phyogs mtshon tsam brjod pa la/ mkhan rin po che khong gi thun mong min pa'i tshe rabs 30

mkhan chen chos kyi gra ga sa pa 'i rto gas ba rjo da/ las kyi bla ma ni skyabs rje zhe chen kong sprul rin po che pad+ma dri med ces bya ba de nyid yin gsungs shing / rje de nyid kyis thugs brtse ba chen pos rdzogs pa chen po'i sems klong man ngag gi sde gsum dang / khyad par rin chen gter mdzod kyi kha skong kong sprul yon tan rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gro lod kyi sgrub skor dang hūṃ sgrub chen mo sogs chos tshan mang po zhig bzhugs pa de/ da dung bka' rgya ma bkrol ba yin yang /de res khyed la gtad pa yin gsungs nas de rnams kyi smin byed kyi dbang dang / grol byed kyi gdams pa rgyab brten gyi lung bcas gzhan las lhag pa'i tshul gyis thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung nas yongs su rdzogs pa gnang gsan bzhes/ a bu lha sgang rin po che'i sku drung nas/ klong chen mdzod bdun dang / don khrid skor gsum rang grol skor gsum sogs rgyab chos cha tshang dang / rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pas mdzad pa'i snying thig than mong phyi nang gi sngon 'gro dran ༄pa nyer bzhag dang lag len 'debs pa/ sgom phyogs dris lan bcas dang / rdzogs chen dpal sprul rin po che'i kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung / mi pham rin po che'i rdo rje tshig bdun gyi 'grel ba pad+ma dkar po dang sngon 'gro thar lam rab gsal sogs rdzogs pa chen po'i chos skor phal mo cher bshad khrid dang tshig khrid 'bog khrid dang dmar khrid bsdus khrid sogs ci rigs pa'i sgo nas gsan bsam yun ring du bgyis te yang yang thugs su bstar bar mdzad/ gzhan yang bla ma rin 31

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtog sa brjo da dang ga su nga rtsom / po che kun dga' dpal ldan mchog nas kyang / chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod dang tshig gsum gnad du brdeg pa'i man ngag sogs zhib gsan mdzad do/ /de ltar sku tshe hril bor theg rtse'i rnal 'byor la nyams bzhes cha bo'i rgyun gyis ting 'dzin kho na'i nyams len la gzhol ༄bar mdzad pa'i mthus/ brgyud gsum bla ma'i byin rlabs thugs la 'phos te gdod ma'i rgyal srid la rang dbang 'byor bar gyur pa lags so/ /de ltar mdo sngags rig gzhung dang bcas pa'i gsan yig zhib tshags lag son ma byung ba'i dbang gis chos rje bla ma'i mdzad rnam du ji bzhin bkod du ma btub la/ 'dir gtso che ba rags rim 'ga' re sa bcad kyi khongs mi stong ba tsam du bkod yod/ gang ltar yang chos rje dam pa 'di nyid/ zhe rdzogs gnyis kho nar mi lo bcu drug gi bar thos bsam gyi bya ba kho nas dus 'da' bar mdzad do/ /de yang deng sang gi slob gnyer mkhan bzhin dpe klog yam me ba lan re gnyis tsam dang / tshig zin dang bshad yam 'ga' re blo la 'okhyol thub pa tsam dang bshad lung gi rgyun tsam thob pa'i ngom par byas nas dpe cha ba yin mdog gyis gzhan la chos 'chad khul bgyis pa lta bu dang gzhi nas mi 'dra la/ khong gis 'tsho ba bsod snyom kho na la brten nas dka' spyad snying rus kyi sgo nas thos bsam la gus rtag gi brtson pa drag pos gsan bsam lhur bzhes mdzad pa zhig yin te/ sgrub pa nyams len gyi skabs ma smos par dpe cha sbyang skabs kho nar mtshon na/32

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rto gas ba rjod / zla 'od yod rang la zla ba'i 'od brgyud de dpe gzigs mdzad/ zla 'od med skabs spos me kho nas yig phreng ded nas nam phyed brgal tsam la dpe gzigs rkyang pa mdzad/ de nas phyag mchod bsnyen sgrub la gzhol te nam cha gsum gyi cha re tsam ma gtogs gzim srol med ces chos khrid kyi skabs rnams su gsungs pa slob tshogs yongs kyis thos pa ltar ro/ /mdor na mdo sngags kyi gzhung gang la thos bsam byas kyang gzhung de'i rtsa ba thugs la bzung nas/ spyi don/ mtha' dpyad/ stong than/ dka' 'grel/ sdom tshig sogs dpe cha de'i phyogs sa gtogs ri ring ri ringapa'i rgya bod mkhas pa'i bzhed gzhung du mar dpe gzigs dang thugs 'dzin mang du gnang / yang yang zhib mos dpyad pa sogs mdzad pas/dngos bstan dang shugs bstan gyi don dang / drang nges kyi khyad par gsar rnying mkhas pas bzhed phyogs/ rang lugs kyi grub mtha'i 'dzin mtshams dang / gzhan la brgal brtag byed pa'i skabs sogs su lung rigs kyi rtsod pa 'phen stangs/ don dang mi 'gal ba'i khas len 'dzin tshul nyams len gyi tshe rgyud la sbyor lugs sogs mdor na yongs 'dzin dam pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen de nyid kyis ji ltar 'doms pa'i tshig dang don gyi cha ma lus par dpar gyis btab pa bzhin wa ler thugs la nges par mdzad pa yin la/ de las gzhan du nang du sos dal dang bag yangs su sdod pa'am/ phyi ru rnam g.yeng dang rtsed 'jo sogs kyis dus tshod gron par byed pa ni nam yang 33

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtog sa brjo da dang ga su nga rtsom / mdzad pa'i srol gzhi nas med de nyin re bzhin sku phyag stong re dang snga thun dang gung thun bcad cing rgyun du dpe gzigs chags med mdzadade zhal 'don bzlas brjod la brtson pa las phyi rol du rnam g.yeng sogs gzhan dang rtsed mo byas nas cung zad kyang bzhugs srol med ces zhal nas gsungs pa ltar ro/ / smras pa/khyed sku lang tsho phra mo'i dus nyid nas/ /thab bstan rin chen sgron me 'bar ba'i gling / /༄ka:dpal zhe rdzogs chos kyi skyed tshal du/ /thos bsam sbrang rtsi'i bcud la ngom med rol/ /thog mar dbu phar 'dul mngon tshad gzhung ste/ /bka' pod lnga 'am gzhung chen bcu gsum la/ /gus rtag brtson pa brgya yis gtan la phab/ /mkhas pa'i grags snyan dbyar rnga'i sgra bzhin ldir/ /slar yang mtshan nyid theg pas ma ngom par /sangs rgyas dngos byon rnam 'dren du ma las/ /rdo rje theg pa spyi dang khyad par du/ /bla med rdo rje snying po'i smin grol gsan/ /gsang sngags snga 'gyur che ba drug ldan gyi/ /snyan brgyud yo ga gsum gyi man ngag la/ /34

mkhan chen chos kyi grag sa pa 'i rto gas ba rjo da/ ring nas thugs kyi dgongs nyams lhur bzhes pas/ /nyams rtogs yon tan gter kha klong du rdol/ /rim gnyis ting 'dzin sgo brgya cig car du/ /yongs su grol ba'i klong du rtsen mdzad de/ /smin grol chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed pa las/ /byin rlabs 'dod pa 'jo ba'i skal bzang thob /ces skabs bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gsum pa/ mthar mkhas dang grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs te bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don mdzad pa/mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas ris med rgyal ba'i bstan pa mi nyams gong 'phel du mdzad pa'i skor dang / grub pa'i go 'phang brnyes pa'i lag rjes lha dang bla mas lung bstan pa sogs khyad par du mdzad pa 'ga' zhig brjod pa'i skor/ bshad sgrub las kyi 'khor lo chen po rnam gsam phyag tu bstar te legs mdzad ༄snang ba dam pa'i phrin las khyab brdal du spel ba'i skor/dang po ni/ mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas ris med rgyal ba'i bstan pa mi nyams gong 'phel du mdzad pa'i skor la/35

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / rje nyid dgung grangs sum cu so gsum dus snga 'gyar gyi chos sde 'khor stogadong dgon zhes bya ba'i gdan sa chen po der phebs nas 'dus sde brgya phrag lhag tsam rab tu byung / dam chos 'dul ba'i 'chad nyan dang / gzhi gsum gyi lag len phyag tu bstar te dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde dang bca' khrims spel/ sdom gsum rnam nges rtsa 'grel gyi bshad pa gnang / chos grwa gsar 'dzugs gnang ba'i dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ mdzod rtsa 'grel sogs mngon pa gong 'og gi gzhung la 'chad nyan rgya cher mdzad/ rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lha'i gzhung spyod 'jug sogs dbu ma'i skor dang / sher phyin sogs byams chos skor bcas gzhung chen po rnams la dpe khrid zhib gnang rgyun ring mdzad/ gzhan yang blo sbyong gi skor dang bslab bya'i rigs mang du gnang / sgrub brgyud kyi sde gsar spel gnang ba la rtsa gsum sogs kyi smin grol dang / bsnyen yig sgom rim bcas mdzub khrid gnang ba'i srol phyes te bshad sgrub gnyis ldan gyi chos sde chen po zhig tu gyur pa lags so/ /yang g.yu khog tu rje btsun sgrol ma'i gnas tā ri zhes bya ba'i dben khrod nyams dga' bar rje nyid rgyun ring bzhugs pa'i tshe/las ldan gyi slob bu mang po la dbu phar sogs gzhung gi bshad pa rgya cher mdzad/ man ngag blo sbyong gi skor ci rigs par bstsal te brgyud 'dzin mang du 'phel ba byung / yul phyogs de'i dad ldan mang tshogs la skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya dang / rgyu 'bras kyi rnam bzhag sogs chos 36

mkhan chen chos kyi grag sa pa 'i rtogs ba rjo da/ sbyin gyi mdzad pa rgya cher spel ba sogs gzhan phan gyi mdzad pa rgya che ba byung ngo / /yang dgung grangs drug cu re dgur bzhes pa tsam na si khron zhing chen bod yig slob grwas gdan zhus ltar zla ba gsum lhag tsam la slob grwa'i dge rgan mkhyen yangs dam pa mang po'i thugs bzhed dang bstun te gzhung spyod 'jug rtsa 'grel mi nyag 'grel chen bshad pa zhib rgyas su gnang / yang mi nyag sa yi thig le dpal lha sgang du zhing chen nang bstan slob grwa'i gtan bzhugs kyi dge rgan du spyan drangs te lo ngo lnga lhag tsam la bzhugs/ 'di'i skabs su gtso bo dkar mdzes khul dang rnga ba khul bde chen rang skyong khul bcas rang skyong khul gsum gyi sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi dgon pa chig stong la nye ba tsam yod pa de las bstan bdag dang / bla sprul gtso bor gyur pa'i grwa gzhon rnams la rgyugs sprad byas te dngos zhugs kyi slob ma bsdu len byas par brten/snga zhugs su dam pa'i skyes chen mang po zhal slob tu bsdus te mdo phyogs kyi dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'chad nyan rgyun ring mdzad pas dngos slob mkhas shing grub pa mang du 'phel te rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas pa'i bka' drin gyi gsos sa gyar to/ /༄༄yang dgung grangs bdun cu don gsum bzhes par rdzogs chen shrī seng ha'i chos grwa chen mor rje nyid gdan drangs te blo gsal skal bzang gi gdul bya ches mang po la rtogs dka' ba dge 'dun nyi shu'i bshad pa sogs dbang rnon kho na'i sbyang bya mkhas pa rnams kyi spyod yul du gyur 37

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtog sa ba rjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / pa'i gzhung gi skor mang po zhib khrid gnang bas mkhyen rab phul du byung ba'i blo gsal dbang rnon rnams thugs shin tu mnyes te a la la deng dus su 'di 'dra ba'i mkhas pa zla dang bral ba'i sde snod 'dzin pa zhig ches ngo mtshar che zhes bsngags pa'i me tog gi sil ma lan brgyar phul zhing gtsug gi cod pan gyis zhabs kyi pad mor gtugs/ yang 'di'i skabs su dkar mdzes zhing chen nang bstan slob grwa chen mos gdan zhu phul te mkhan rin po che sku 'khor bcas dkar mdzes su gser zhal bsgyur/ skabs der mkhas grub kyi dbang phyug chen po rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor pa mchog sprul shes rab 'od zer gang nyid gtso bor mdzad pas 'dus sde rgya mtsho lta bus/ dar gdugs rgyal mtshan rnga dung sil snyan sogs mchod pa'i legs tshogs kyis mdun bsus te gtsug lag khang du spyan drangs nas 'jigs pa med pa'i rdo rje'i khri la zhabs sor bkod/ de tshe than mong dang than mong ma yin pa'i legs ra ra bshad chos kyi sbyin pa'i dga' ston mchog gis legs skyes phun sum tshogs pa'i bka' drin bstsal bas dge slob rnams dang dad 'dus mang tshogs bcas dga' spro zol med ngang dad mos bla lhag tu 'phel te zhabs rdul spyi bos mchod/ yang de rjes su rgyal sa pe cin du mtho rim nang bstan slob grwa chen mos gdan zhus dge rgan du spyan drangs te mkhas shing grub pa'i dge rgan dang dam pa'i skyes chen gyi slob ma bla sprul grangs mang po bzhugs pa la/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi bstan 38

mkhan chen chos kyi grag sa pa 'i rto gas ba rjo da/ 'byung lo rgyus dang grub mtha' sogs mdo dang rgyud kyi bshad pa rgya cher gnang / skabs der sa dge bka' rnying gi grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i mkhas grub grangs mang po dang / rgya nag gi bla grwa ches mang po bcas 'khor 'dus pa rgya mtsho lta bu la/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla ma'i dbang dang tshe dbang sogs smin grol gyi gdams pa zab mo rnams thugs dgyes pa chen pos bstsal/ de tshe rgya mi'i slob ma sogs dag pa'i snang ba can du ma'i mthun snang du rje nyid sangs rgyas sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po'i sku dngos su mthong ba dang / der ma zad dbang rdzas so so'i steng na'ang sangs rgyas sman gyi bla ma'i sku sha stag bzhugs pa mjal bas lha dang bla ma la phyir mi ldog pa'i dad pa brtan po thob cing 'ga' zhig dbang don gyi rtogs pa brnyes pa'ang byung ngo / /lar rje nyid dgung grangs bdun cu brgal ba bzhes tsam nas gtso bo gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol dang rgyud kyi 'chad nyan shugs che ba mdzad/ khyad par snga 'gyur 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i chos bka' zab mo rnams khyab brdal du bstsal bas gang 'dod yid kyi re ba ngom par mdzad cing / de las kyang rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi thugs kyi gsang mdzod las brtol ba'i man ngag rdzogs pa chen po'i chos skor klong chen mdzod bdun rgyab chos bcas dang / thams cad mkhyen pa 'jigs med gling ba'i dgongs pa'i klong las rdol ba'i bstan bcos chen po yon tan rin po che'i mdzod rtsa 'grel sogs kyis mtshon snga 'gyar yo ༄39

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / ka gsum gyi man ngag gi skor ha cang mang po zhib khrid dang nyams len ngo sprod kyi rigs du ma yang yang bstsal/ skabs skabs su las dang po ba'i rigs la rgyal sras lag len/ bshes spring spyod 'jug sogs blo sbyong gi skor rnams kyang gnang nas gzhan phan gyi mdzad pa kho nas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa yin no/ /mkhan rin po che nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gsang rtsom yang / sgrol ma'i 'grel pa atal sngon po'i do shal rig mi chosi mi/rdo /dang / yum ka'i 'grel pa puṇ+ḍa ri ka'i do shal zhes pa/ sa lam gyi rnam bzhag rin chen them skas/ dge 'dun nyi shu'i bshad pa/ gzhan 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i 'grel pa chen mo gsal rgyas cha tshang ba zhig ljags rtsom mdzad pa yod kyang bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib kyi dbang gis da lta dpe rgyun 'ga' las mi bzhugs so/ /de ltar dam pa 'di'i mkhas grub kyi mdzad pa ni ji bzhin brjod pa'i mtha' rdzogs par dka' yang re zhig phyogs mtshon pa tsam zhig rnam thar rgya mtsho spro ba'i sa bon du dmigs te rtswa rtse'i zil thig tsam rags bshad byas par mchog gi zhal slob rnams nas skabs 'di rgyas spros zhig phyag las bzhes rogs cis kyang zhu zhu/ smras pa/ e ma khyod ni yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bshes/ /srid gsum 'gro ba'i ma 'dres pa yi gnyen/ /chos kyi rgyus la mkhas pa'i grags pa ni/ /dbyar gyi rnga bzhin lho rgyud phyogs na ldir/ /40

mkhan chen chos kyi grag sa pa 'i rto gas ba rjo da/ mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i bstan pa gser gyi ri/ /dus ngan rgya mtshor bying la nye ba na/ /bshad sgrub 'jug pa bcu pa'i 'phrul thabs kyis/ /gyen du 'degs pa'i thugs bskyed bla na mtho/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po klong chen rab 'byams kyi/ /mdzod chen bdun dang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba sogs/ /zab pa'i man ngag snying po'i chos 'khor bskor/ /sgrub brgyud 'dzin pa'i zhal slob bgrang las 'das/ /zab gter rdo rje snying po'i bcud/ /nang sgrub mkha' 'gro'i sgrub gzhung gi /gsal byed 'bru 'grel pad+ma dkar/ /sar ba sar ba'i do shal 'phyang / /tshig dang don gyi sbyor ba la/ /mkhas pa'i rnam 'gyur tshad du phyin/ /bka' gter rgyud kyi dgongs pa'i gnad/ /mngon du byung ba grub pa'i rtags/ /'di 'dra'i rdo rje'i tshig gi rgya mdud ni/ /rnam dpyod mkhyen pa'i rtsal gyis bde blag tu/ /gab pa'i zab gnad ljon cher bgrol 'di yis/ /gangs can mkhas pa'i thugs mdzod dgyes pa skong / /legs bshad skyes kyi dga' ston 'di mthong tshe/ /sa 'dir dge dbang gnyis pa 'di ko su/ /a la la zhes mang thos blo ldan dag /zhal gyi dkyil 'khor zla gzhon dpal la 'khu/ /de slad cher snyigs lnga bdo'i dus/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i gar stabs kyis/ /grags snyan dkar po'i ba dan che/ /'og min zhing gi mthongs su snyegs/ /rnam pa 41

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjod dang ga su nga rtsom / de lta'i dge mtshan la/ /'chi med dbang po'i mig stong gis/ /blta ba'i rim pa ma rdzogs par/ /ngal bas bsam gtan gling la zhugs/ /phyogs bral skye bo'i zur phud rtse/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo la reg ste/ /chos kyi 'khor sgyur chen po zhes/ /grags pa don dang ldan la ltos/ /de lta'i 'chad rtsod rtsom pa yi/ /phul byung mkhas pa'i legs mdzad la/ /mkhas grub bye bas bstod dbyangs kyis/ /bsngags pa'i me tog lan brgyar spros/ /zhes skabs bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ / gnyis pa/ grub pa'i go 'phang brnyes pa'i lag rjes lha dang bla mas lung bstan pa sogs khyad par can gyi mdzad pa 'ga' zhig brjod pa'i skor la ni/ mkhan rin po che nyid dgung grangs bzhi bcu lhag bzhes tsam na rig gnas gsar brje'i dus 'gyur gyi dbang gis khrims khang du bzhugs pa'i skabs shig na bstan dgon thams cad rtsa med byas pa dang skye dgu rnams kyang bkres skom 'jigs skrag sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig gis mnar ba'i tshe/ da ni nges par ston pa'i bstan pa rin po che sgron me'i bskal pa bzang po de sprin rum 'thag pos khebs nas bstan ༄'gror bde skyid kyi snang ba de myur du nub 'gro ba 'dra snyam du thugs skyo ba tshad med pa'i ngang nas lhag pa'i lha rgyal yum rje btsun sgrol mar rtse gcig tu gsol ba drag po btab pa'i rkyen las mnal lam du brag dkar po dbyibs snying 'dra ba zhig gi phyogs thams cad spang ljongs kyi 42

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa 'i rto gas ba rjo da/ tshal rab tu yangs pa me tog sna tshogs kyis mdzes shing brgyan pa shin tu nyams dga' zhing blta na sdug pa zhig gi dbus nyid du/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog sngo ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis can zhig bzhugs pa zhal mngon sum du mjal ba'i tshe/ khong gis mos gus tshad med pas gsol ba yang btab pas/ 'phags ma'i phyag g.yon gyis phyag rgya mdzad pa'i srin mdzub kyi rtser lta yig zhig yod pa mjal/dal zhig gis srog snying gi yi ge lta yig de nyid ang ki bdun pa zhig tu gyar/ ang ki de yang gnas 'gyar nas yi ge shī lo ka'i gzags su riri rgya ni mi ri ri'o ///reshar ba 'di ltar/ sprel lo sprel zla shar ba'i tshe/ /bstan pa 'phel ba 'go tshugs nas/ /bgrang bya phrag gnyis brgyad 'das pas/ /bstan pa'i me ro gzhung nas ldang / /zhes bkra lam mer gsal bzhin pa'i ngang dbyings su yal te mi snang bar gyur ces gsungs pa bzhin lhag pa'i lhas 'khrul med rdo rje'i tshig gis lung bstan pa kho na ltar rjes nas bstan pa dar ba sogs byung ba yin no/ /yang de rjes 1975lor dgung grangs lnga bcu nga bdun bzhes pa'i skabs shig tu bad kan gyis sku snyung zhig bzhes par/ gzim rmis su rje btsun mi la byon nas tshe dbang zhig gnang / de tshe bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing bdud rtsi zhal du bzhes par/ bum rdzas kyi ro dngos su myong du yod pa zhig thugs nyams su shar zhes gsungs/ nang par rje btsun gyis gsungs pa'i tshig rnams thugs nas dbyangs su gyer bar mdzad pa sku mdun du 43

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtog sa brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / 'khod pa slob ma mang pos thos so/ /de rjes rim par sku bsnyun las grol zhes bshad do/ /yang de'i rjes su sku snyung drag po zhig bzhes te sman bcos sogs kyis phan pa ma byung ba'i skabs/ khong gi bla ma ngag dbang bka' drin can byon nas tshe dbang zhig bskur ba mnal lam du byung bas/ bsnyun gzhi zla ba sgra gcan gyis gnod pa las grol ba bzhin gzhi med du song zhes gsungs/ yang rab tshes me rta lor/ khong gi zhal slob mkhan mdo sde mgon po sku mdun na yod pa'i tshe gsungs par mdang dgong nga'i rmi lam na gling 'dir me chen po zhig mched de yul dang ri lung thams cad gang ste shin tu 'jigs shing ya nga ba zhig byung / ngas rje btsun sgrol ma la gsol ba drag po btab pa'i mod la me sgo cung zad phye bas nga rang thar song ba zhig rmis/ o kyis kyang sgrol ma 'bum ther zhig khas len gyis dang chos 'go thon pa zhig 'ong gsungs/ yang sku na gzhon dus shrī seng chos grwar slob gnyer la brtson pa'i skabs shig na bsod snyoms la phebs par/ rong pa zhig gis gnas tshang g.yar nas khang ba'i yang steng zhig tu gzim mal bcas te gzim yod par/ nam gyi phyed cha tsam na bud med skad gseng mthon po can zhig gis/ chos grags zhes mtshan nas bos tshe khong gis a zhes brjod pa dang mnyam du dbu yar bkyags nas gzigs tshe/ khong gi gzim mal gyi sngas mgo'i phyogs sa nas kyi bam po'i phon po chen po ༄zhig brtsigs pa'i steng der rdo chen po cig gis mnan yod pa de lhung 44

mkhan chen chos kyi grag sa pa'i rto gas ba rjo da/ ste dbu sngas kyi steng du brgyab nas sngangs skrag cig 'ong ba tsam las sku la gnod pa ma byung gsungs/ nga'i ming nas 'bod mkhan gyi bud med de rje btsun sgrol ma yin gsungs/ de la sogs pa lha dang bla ma sku lus kyi grib ma bzhin 'bral ba med pa'i mtshan ma mang du 'byung ngo / /da dung gzhan yang khyad par gyi mdzad pa 'ga' zhig brjod par bya ste/ru dam o rgyan bsam gtan chos gling gi yang dben dam can sgang zhes bya ba'i dben khrod du sgrub pa mdzad pa'i skabs/ sgrub phug gi brag ngos der nor bu'i dbyibs lta ba'i ri mo 'bar du dod pa zhig ༄ ༄yod pa las/ chu shin tu dwangs shing bsil ba yan lag brgyad ldan zhig mched de zhal du thim pa de 'dra yang yang byung gsungs/ de sogs gnas kyis gang zag byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma khyad par ba mang du byung zhes sgrub grogs mang pos gleng ba rjes nas thos so rta shar zhi khro'i gnas ri de'i dbu rtse chos sku'i sgrub gnas su rgyun ring bzhugs/ skabs der nyin gcig bud med rgan pa zhig gis mkhan rin po che la gsol zho zhig 'bul du 'ong bar/ khong thugs dgyes tshul gyis de ring rten 'brel zhig brtags dgos gsungs nas/ zho'i kha spris shig phyag sor gyi rtse mos blangs te sgrub phug gi brag ngos su a yig cig phyag bris mdzad/ rjes nas yi ge de a rang byon du gyur nas thams cad ya mtshan pa byung ngo / /da lta'ang mjal rgyu yod/ yang rje nyid dgung grangs bdun cu don dgu bzhes tsam la/ gzim khang gi 45

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtog sa brjo da dang ga su nga rtsom / mdun thad rtsig ngos su ston pa thugs rje can la bstod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa zhig mthong snang du shar ba 'di ltar/ gang gi zhabs sen lha brgya'i cod pan dag gis btegs pa'i khrir/ /gang gi mtshan dpe bsod nams bye bas rab tu bskrun pa'i sku/ /gang gi mkhyen pa ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes thugs/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i lam ston shākya seng ger gus pas 'dud/ /de 'dra zhig 'ja' 'od dang bcas pa bkra lam mer shar ba byung zhes zhal slob kyi mchog mkhan bkra shis la gsungs/ yang nyan shul mkhan mdo sde mkhan rin po che'i sku mdun du bcar ba'i skabs shig na/ khong gi mdun cog gi steng na sngon chad mthong thos sa ma gyur pa'i rdzogs pa chen po'i tshigs sa bcad pa'i shrī ri ring riri calo ka 'ga' yod pa zhig bzhag 'dug pa mjal bas 'di ci lags zhus pas/ de nga rang gi mi lam na bya khrung khrung 'ga' nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phur bzhin snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis mgur tshig 'di 'dra kha shas smras par gsungs/ yang yum ka'i rnam bshad ljags rtsom gnang skabs phyag dpe kun 'thor zhig du song bas thugs kyi rnam dpyod gcig pu la brten de rtsom 'bri mdzad/ skabs shig gnas yul nyer bzhi'i bshad pa zhig ma rnyed thabs med 'dug pas ci drag rgyud brtag gnyis cig e rnyed dgongs bzhin pa'i mtshan mor gzim lam du mi zhig slebs de khyod la rgyud brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa dgos na/de ni bu gnyis nang a kho la yod zer ba rmis/ phyi nyin a kho sdod pa'i 46

mkhan chen chos kyi gra gas pa 'i rto gas ba rjo da/ grong pa de'i mi zhig sman bsten du 'ong bar kho la skad cha nan po zhig bskur ba nyin bdun brgyad kyi mtshams su khong gi phyag tu dpe cha de chud gsungs/ grong pa de rta mi nyin lam brgal tsa na yod do/ /yang tha tshig skabs rig 'dzin 'jigs gling gi rnam thar zhig e lon dgongs pas phyi nyin khong gi gzim spyil gyi nye 'khor na tsha khang rnying pa zhig yod pa'i khrod nas yum ka dgongs gter phab tshul cha tshang zhig phyag tu rnyed pa yin gsungs/ yang rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me glang lo'i hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer lnga'i dgong mor 'od gsal nyams kyis snang bar 'di ltar byung ste/ mdo khams smad kyi char mi nyag lha sgang gi dpal ri nyin thang bya bar/ lha shing shug pa'i tshal gyi dbus su/ brag chung ngu la phug pa'i kha shar bstan pa zhig gi nang / ri bong kha dog dung ltar dkar ba/ rna ba gnyis ring zhing rtse mor spu tshom re skyes pa/zhal khyim dwangs la mdzes pa/ ri dwags phal ba las ring du 'phags pa zhig 'dug pas/ de la kho bos ngo mtshar dang bcas khyed su yin dris pas/ nga ri bong blo ldan shes rab yin zer/ khyed 'di na ci byed dris pas/ kho bo ni sngon byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la rtsa kun bzang zhig phul nas byang chub du sems bskyed pa ste/ de yi bsod nams kyis snying stobs dang gzi mdangs lhag par che bas/ gcan gzan gtum pos glags btsal kyang glag mi rnyed cing /yul 'di'i rang byung bdud rtsi'i chu mig dang / rtswa'i myu gu gang legs 47

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / par longs su spyod cing / byams pa dang gus pa la sogs yon tan khyad par can mnga' ba'i ri dwags kyi slob bu 'khor tshogs dang bcas ri dwags kyi rgyal po'i tshul yun du gnas pa zhig ste/ kho bo la 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa'i rtags spu mdog dung ltar dkar ba dang /shes rab mchog thob pa'i rtags su rna rtse ring zhing rno ba dang / bzod pa la gnas pa'i rtags su mig tho rangs kyi skar chen ltar gsal ba/tshul khrims rnam par dag pas dri mas ma spag pa dang / bsam pa la g.yo sgyu med pas spu ma 'dzings pa dang / skye ba du mar sbyin pa'i stobs kyis lus rgyas shing mdzes pa dang / dge bcu mi ngom par spyad pas 'od dang ldan pa dang / byang chub yan lag gi me tog bkram pas dri zhim pa dang / de bzhin bsam gtan dang brtson 'grus rtsom pa la sogs pa yun du gnas pa'i rtags la sogs pa dpag tu med par mnga' tshul shin tu mang po zhig smras so/ /de nas re zhig tu rmi lam gyi snang tshal cung zad 'gya ba'i mod la/ ri bong de mi snang bar gyar ba'i risigi risi mi risi tshishul du/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgra dbyangs mi zad sgrog pa'i rgyal po/gur gum gyi mdog lta bu mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ sku la ngur smrig gsol ba de nyid gzi byin gyi 'od dang bcas/ sngar ri bong 'dug pa'i phug pa chung ngu der byon nas/ rtswa'i gdan la rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs te/bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon pa'i brdar phyag g.yas sa gnon dang /48

mkhan chen chos kyi gra ga sa pa 'i rto gas ba rjo da/ thugs mnyam par ma bzhag pa mi mnga' ba'i brdar phyag g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad de/ dgyes pa'i mdangs dang bcas/ nga ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgra dbyangs mi zad sgrog pa'i rgyal po yin zhes lan gsum gsungs pa dang / rigs kyi bu khyed skye ba 'di'i 'og tu/ lam log pa dang / lam dman par mi gtong / de nas rim par rigs bzang por skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i thugs snang rab tu gsal ba zhig byung gsungs so/ /da ni gzhan dag la bskal don du song ba'i gzags med sha za 'dre srin gyi rigs mang po sgrib med ye shes spyan ༄gyis gsal bar gzigs pa'i tshul las brtsams te ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa 'ga' zhig brjod par bya ste/ de yang sngon mkhan rin po che nyid 'khor gdong dgon du bzhugs pa'i skabs/ snyi rgyal gyis skabs blta glag 'tshol mang du byas par/ nyin gcig khos za 'og gi ber zhig gyon te zhal dmar nag khrag gi mdog lta bu zhig byas nas/gzims khang gi sgo nas yar nang du 'ong grab byas par/ khong gis yi dam gyi lha sngags ting 'dzin brtan pos/ nga rgyal gyis gzir bas phyir log kyang / mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur bcas khyod kyis stong nyid kyis rgyas gdab kyang nga khyod la mi skrag nga smyo shul ngag chen gyi slob ma bla ma bkra shis zer ba'i mkhyen kyang mi mkhyen pa ltar byed pa de la skrag de las gzhan su la'ang mi 'jigs zer bzhin phyi rol tu song ngo de rjes lan mang por kho sleb 'dug kyang nga la gnod pa phra mo tsam yang 49

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtog sa brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / byed ma myong gsungs/ de ni rgyal tshab byams pa mgon pos/ chos bzang rig pa'i rnam dpyod bsam pa can/ /rtag tu bdud kyis bar chad byed pa med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po rnams la nam du'ang bar chad bdud kyi rigs mi 'byung zhing gal te byung yang gnod pas brdzu mi nus par gsungs pa de dag mngon du gyur pa lags so/ /yang rje nyid mi nyag tu bzhugs skabs lha sgang du gri ru shi ba'i grwa rgan zhig yod pa des kho rang gi gzugs dngos su bstan nas lan mang por khong gi sku drung du 'ong bar nyin zhig khong sleb pa dang mnyam du khong gis lhag pa'i lha rje btsun sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pa'i mod la rje btsun ma'i sku rten de las 'od zer zhig byung nas kho la phog pas mi snang bar gyur/ de nas bzung 'ong rgyu mi 'dug gsungs/ yang khong dang slob ma mdo sde mgon po dpon slob gnyis rdzas tha ru bzhugs skabs/ nyin cig mtshan mo srod kyi dus tsam la gnam mtsho sprul sku'i sku ring nas yod pa'i yul 'dre rgyal gshed ngan pa zhig yod pa de 'ong nas/ nga yi ming la mthar phyin 'bod pa yin zer nas/ rje yi sku tshe la gnod pa brtsam pa'i grab byas pa'i tshe/ khong gis byams dang snying rje tshad med pa'i ngang nas/ bdag gis dus gsum gyi dge ba'i tshogs ji snyed mchis pa mtha' dag khyod la sbyin/khyod kyi lus dang sems kyi sdug bsngal ma lus pa bdag la smin par gyar cig ces thugs smon mdzad bzhin bdag gzhan mnyam brje yi sto 50

mkhan chen chos kyi gra ga sa pa 'i rto gas ba rjo da/ man ngag zab mo bsgom pas/ rgyal po khos khyod la dri ngan zhig bro bar 'dug zer nas sna lag pas 'gebs bzhin phyi rol tu song nas mi snang bar gyur/ de 'dra lan mang po 'ong yang gnod pa ma byung gsungs/gzhan yang snga rjes su mi ma yin gyis gnod pa rtsom pa'i rigs mang po byung yang bdag bas gzhan gces rin chen byang chub kyi sems rin po che yang yang bsgoms nas smon lam btab pas la kha'i na bun bzhin yul med zang thal du song gsungs/ yang khong nyid dgun gcig la mi nyag rdo zam du bzhugs tshe/ gnas der lha 'dre'i 'tshub lhong shin tu che bar gzigs shing / skabs der khong nam mkha' ru bya ltar 'phur nas der gnas pa'i mi min gyi lha 'dre rnams la dbang bskur zhing bka' dang tha tshig gis dam la bzhag pa sogs kyi nyams snang zhig shar 'dug gsungs/ yang khong nyid kyi mched po zhig lnga lam du phyin par rgyal gshed cig gi dbang du song nas sha za myur mgyog can du gyur te kun tu rgyu zhing 'khyams pa'i tshe/ khong gi gshin po de'i ming bos te khyod rgyal 'dre'i dbang du song nas 'khrul bar gda' yi/ khyed kyis lha dang bla ma dran par gyis la rig pa dbyings su gtod ces 'khrul ba rang grol gyi gdams pa bstan pas de ma thag phyi nang snod bcud rten dang brten par bcas/ dag pa mkha' spyod kyi zhing 'ba' zhig tu gyar nas nam mkha'i dbyings sa ta la la 'phar bzhin rdo rje'i risi tshi dmi ༅ riri banyams mgur gyi glu dbyangs sna tshogs len pa'i nyams kyi snang ba yun 51

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjod dang ga su nga rtsom / ring du shar zhes sku tsha pad blos gsungs/ yang sngon chad khong rdzogs chen dben khrod dam can sgang du bzhugs skabs/ gzim rmis su bud med rgan pa gnyis sleb nas rang re gnyis shi nas lo brgya phrag lhag pa zin kyang da dung thar ba ma thob par bar dor 'khyam bzhin sdug bsngal myong gin yod/ khyed kyis bsngo smon zhig gnang bar zhu zhus te/dngul gor mo zhig sku mdun du bzhag nas song bar phyi nyin de la dmigs te thugs smon zab rgyas gnang ngo / /slar smras pa/'phags chen sems dpa'i sgyu 'phrul chos kyi rje/ /khyod ni sngon nas slob pa mthar son kyang / /skal bzang lam gyi 'jug rim nges pa'i slad/ /so thar byang sems rig pa 'dzin pa yi/ /bslab pa srung zhing dam tshig la gnas te/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i yon tan rim gyis bslab/ /dran pa nyer bzhag nas bzung byang chos dang / /rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rgya mtshor bsnyen sgrub sogs/ /rim gnyis ting 'dzin sgom pa'i rnal 'byor brtson/ /las rlung dbu mar dag pa'i rten 'byung dang / /a wa dhu ti'i mdud rgya grol ba las /'gags med chos kyi mdzod chen klong du rdol/ /52

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa 'i rto gas brjod/ dag pa'i lha sku yig 'bru 'byams su klas/ /shin tu lkog gyur gnas kun mngon sum gsal/ /'khor 'das chos rnams lag mthil rdzas bzhin du/ /rnam pa ma 'dres ye shes spyan gyis gzigs/ /zhes bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gsum pa/ bshad sgrub las kyi 'khor lo chen po rnam gsum phyag tu bstar te legs mdzad snang ba dam pa'i phrin las khyab brdal du spel ba'i skor ni/ chos rje dam pa mkhan rin po che dgung grangs drug cu re brgyad bzhes tsa na khams phyogs mi nyag chos kyi yul gru dpal lha sgang mthong grol bsam 'grub gling zhes bya ba'i dpal sa skya ba'i chos sde chen po der snga rjes su rgyun ring bzhugs shing / dang po'i skabs rnams su dpal lha sgang jo bo rin po che zhu ba de sngon rgya bza' kong jos bzhengs pa'i rten rnying skad grags che ba zhig yin/ de ni lha ldan gyi jo bo yid bzhin nor ba shākya ma ne dang byin rlabs mnyam pa zhig rabye ra༅yin mod/ 'on kyang dus 'gyur gyi dbang gis nyams nyes su song ba de slar gso mdzad cing / gzhan gdan sa 'dir sngon jo nang gi grub thob chen po grub dbang kun dga' rin chen zhes/ slob dpon hūṃ chen ka ra'i sprul par grags pa'i grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor chen po de nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i grub thob mchod rten zhes kun la grags che ba 53

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / zhig bzhugs pa de yang nyams gso mdzad/ mdo mkhyen brtse'i rnam thar du drang srong mchod rten zhes bris 'dug gzhan gnas der mchod rten sogs rten bzhengs mang du mdzad skabs/ rab gnas bkra shis mnga' dbul gyi cho ga'i gzhung bsrings te tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya cher phul ba'i tshe/ nam mkha' la dud sprin smug pa sogs phra mo tsam yang med pa'i gnas skabs su/ shar bzhag bra lha rtse'i gnas mdun nas 'ja' zer kha dog sna tshogs rab tu 'phros te jo khang gi rgya phibs steng dang / mchod rten sogs kyi dbu rtser zugs shing / gzhan yang 'ja' gzugs shin tu bkra ba'i bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi dbyibs dang / gzhal yas khang sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan ma khyad par ba mang du byung zhing / de las kyang sgrib pa srab pa'i gang zag dag pa'i snang ba can rnams kyi mthong snang la/ yi dam gyi lha dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro grangs med pa mjal zhing / yi ge a ra r+ghaṃ sogs rgya bod kyi yig gzugs sna tshogs shar ba mthong nas ngo mtshar gtam gyi rol mo mang du 'khrol ba byung / skabs der phyi gling ba a me ri ka'i zhib 'jug mkhan mi sna kha shas yod pa de dag lhag par ya mtshan de 'dra par mang po blang ba dang / rgyang mthong gis phyogs kun tu bltas pas 'ja' dang 'od kyi gur khyim sogs sa smra mi shes pa'i gzags 'dra min sna rig mi ri pa tshogs yod par smras pa kun gyis thos nas dad spro tshad med 'phel ba byung ngo / /mdor na dbyings nas ye shes pa dngos su spyan drangs te 54

mkhan chen chos kyi gra ga sa pa 'i rto gas ba rjo da/ rten so sor bsnyims te bzhugs su gsol bar mdzad pa'i rtags mtshan mngon sum du byung ba la rtsod pa med cing / sus kyang mngon sum la bsnyon du ga la yod/ yang de'i rjes tsam na lha sgang jo bo rin po che'i mdun du mchod yon sogs mchod pa rgya chen po zhig nyin bdun tsam la phul skabs/ nyi ma gsum pa'i nyin der me tog gi char ha cang mang po zhig bab pa thag nye ring gi mi mang pos mig gi bdud rtsir son/ lar mkhan rin po che khong gis rten bzhengs dang tshogs 'khor sogs kyi skabs nam yin yang 'ja' shar ba dang me tog gi char 'bebs pa sogs rgyun du yod la/ yang khong gis skor cig jo bo rjes phyag btab mdzad pa'i ston pa'i sman sku zhig yod pa de/ sman bla'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbas sa sgrub rten du bzhag yod par/ ston pa'i ༄ ༄sku de la phyogs thams cad nas me tog dkar po dbyibs legs pa ches mang po 'khrungs pa de nyid grwa slob mang pos 'dren byed dbang po'i bdud rtsir son pas dad cing ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su gyur/ yang dam rdzas bdud rtsi chos sman phon chen zhig bsgrubs pa'i skabs/ myong grol ril bu de la shin tu dri bsung gis khyab cing / nang du 'phel gdung ring bsrel phra rags mang pos khyab pa byung / sgrub pa'i gtor ma la gtor skra kha dog sna tshogs kyis khebs shing me tog du ma 'khrungs pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i gnas mang du byung / lar khong gis sgrub pa mdzad pa'i skabs rnams su rgyun du gtor skra dang me tog 'khrungs pa 55

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs ba rjod dang ga su nga rtso ma / sogs sgrub rtags med pa nam yang med ces nye gnas sogs sku 'khor rnams nas gsungs/da ni dam pa khong nyid kyis bshad sgrub chos kyi sgron me sbar te rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che gong du spel ba'i skor 'ga' zhig gling ba la/rgyal rong tsha kho'i phyogs su sngar koḥthog pa'i chos rgyud mtshams gnas dgon zhes yongs grags su mtshams gnas dgon pa 'dus sde brgya phrag lhag brgal tsam mchis pa der phebs nas/ grwa gzhon mang po rab tu byung / 'dul ba gzhi gsum gyi lag len phyag tu bstar de dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i 'chad nyan gyi rgyun spel ba'i chos grwa gsar 'dzugs gnang nas snga gzhug tu khong nyid nas chos khrid dang bslab bya blo sbyong gi rigs mang po dang / r+ghaṃ tshang spyi'i dgon pa'i bca' khrims bcas rin thang dang bral ba'i gdams pa mang du gnang nas mdzad pa'i phyag rjes dri ma med pas rgyun bskyangs/ gzhan yang khams phyogs li thang gi yul grur mi 'gyur dgon zhes bya bar/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs dang rgyud kyi 'chad nyan spel ba'i chos grwa gsar 'dzugs gnang / gzhi gsum lag len dang dge 'dun gyi sde rgya cher spel bas bshad sgrub gnyis ldan gyi chos sde sa rnying grub mtha' ris med kyi gdan sa chen po zhig tu gyar te kun gyis bsngags pa'i me tog 'thor bzhin pa lags so//stoyang khro skyabs sang sang dgon bsam 'grub dar rgyas gling dang / rdzas 56

mkhan chen chos kyi grag sa pa 'i rto gas ba rjo da/ tha dgon mdo sngags bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling dang / tsha kho'i phyogs 'jo ro dgon pa bcas la dbyar gnas gsar 'dzugs mdzad de dam chos 'dul ba'i bstan pa khyab brdal du spel ba sogs kyis rgyal bstan rdzogs ldan dang por bsgyur ba'i rlabs chen gyi mdzad pa shin tu mang ngo / /yang rje nyid kyi rang dgon brag mkhar dgon du dbyar gnas gzhi gsar 'dzugs dang / gzhi gsum sogs 'dul ba'i lag len la 'chad spel gnang / rten bzhengs dang dgon pa nyams gso'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad/ gong du bshad pa'i dgon khag rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i chos dgon mang po la/ smin gling rdor sems kyi cho ga'i sgrub mchod rgyun 'dzugs kyi theb dang yon 'bul bcas rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa rgya che ba du ma phyag tu bstar ba'i dge legs kyi snang bas phyogs kun khyab par mdzad do/ /gzhan yang mi nyag gi sa cha stod smad bar gsum gyi dad ldan mang tshogs khri phrag brgal tsam dang / nyag rong / nyag chu/li thang / rgyal rong / dar mdo/ rta'u sogs sa gnas ches mang po'i dad ldan gyi skye bo pho mo grangs med pa bcas thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung nas/ rnyed bkur dang grags pa don du gnyer ba tsam ma yin par/ gzhan phan don du gnyer ba'i thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pa kho nas/ snying rje'i yul du gyur pa'i snyigs dus sems can bsod nams dman pa'i rigs la/ 'phral du chos kyi byin rlabs 'jug pa'i zab chos mang po'i sgo nas 'gro don rlabs po ches gdul bya grangs 57
