mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtsom / med pa gnas skabs mngon mtho dang mthar thug nges legs kyi go 'phang la myur bar 'god pa'i ched du dgongs nas/ chos 'brel gyi rigs sna tshogs dang / skyabs sdom dang / skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya/smyung gnas sdom pa/ rgyu 'bras kyi rnam bzhag dge sgrub sdig spang /khyad par bde sdug gtong len dang / bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i man ngag zab mo rnams gnang nas chos sbyin rgya mtsho lta bus tshim par mdzad pas 'brel tshad don ldan du gyur/ de las kyang zab lam 'pho ba'i man ngag la brten nas dad ldan khri phrag brgal tsam la 'pho ba thebs pa'i rtags khyad par ba thon/ rgya nag gi slob ma ches mang po la yang 'pho ba'i rtags dang chos kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mtshan ma khyad par ba mang du byung ba sogs gdul bya rjes 'dzin gyi phrin las 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba 'di dag khong gi thugs bskyed dang smon lam gyi mthu mngon du gyur pa lags so/ /spyi lo 1984ste bod rab byung bcu bdun pa'i bgrang bya dang po/ legs sbyar du pra bha wa zhes pa rab byung ste/ spor thang ngam 'byung rtsis pa'i me mo yos bu'i gnam lo'i 'dzum zhal gsar du ngom pa'i bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa'i lo zla bzang po'i skabs dang bstun nas/ skyabs rje mkhan chen rin po che khong nyid si khron zhing chen lnga rig nang bstan slob gling gi dge rgan chen po'i gtso 'gan bzhes te lo lnga mthar phyin tshe/ slar yang gtan du bzhugs dgos pa'i zhu ba nan gyis phul yang zhal bzhes ma mdzad 58

mkhan chen chos kyi grag sa pa 'i rto gas ba rjo da/ par/ chos gzhi gsar 'dzugs kyi thabs la mkhas pa'i mdzad pa bzang pos bstan 'gror sman pa'i rlabs chen gyi phrin las myur du spel ba'i dgongs pa thugs la shar te/ gza' dang skar ma'i 'grub sbyor sogs rten 'brel dge ba'i dus tshes la gdan sa 'tshol du phyin nas dpal lha sgang gi chos sde chen po'i g.yas zur 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po'i gnas ri'i nye 'gram/ sa gzhi la byin chags shing nyams dga' ba/ rtsi bcud dang me tog sna tshogs kyi tshal bkra ba/ chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen 'tshol sla zhing 'gal rkyen dben pa sogs mdor na rgyud sde rnams nas bshad pa'i sgrub gnas kyi mtshan nyid ma tshang ba med pa/ shar phyes/ lho spungs/ nub 'dan/ byang yol ba bres pa 'dra zhing / yar gyi rtse 'dzin dang / mar gyi rten phur/ sa yi srung bzhi dang ka bzhi gdung brgyad sogs gnam sa bar gsum gyi sa dpyad phun sum tshogs pas bkra shis shing byin chags pa/ nyi zla'i 'od 'char snga zhing sdud phyi ba/ mdun du ne'u seng dang me tog gi gling chags pa/ sngon po g.yu 'brug dang khra bo stag gi gdan sogs gdan bzhi'i mtshan nyid legs par tshang ba'i gnas mchog der gdan sa ngos 'dzin gnang ste/rab tu byung ba'i 'dus sde brgya phrag brgal tsam gyis bkra shis pa'i gso sbyong dang / phyogs kun tu rten 'brel snying po'i me tog 'thor te sa 'dul mdzad/ de nas gtsug lag khang dang / rje rang nyid kyi gzim khang spus legs grwa khang bcas kyi so so'i rmang gzhi bskos te rim gyis 59

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjod dang ga su nga rtso ma / yar zla bzhin 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur pa lags/ 'di'i skabs su nam mkha' nas bya 'ol ba zhig glo bur du byung ste dar dkar po dri ma med pa zhig bzung nas 'phur lding gi gar sna tshogs byed bzhin/ bkra shis pa'i bsnyi gnas der 'bul ba ltar byas te 'phang byung bar/ thog ma'i rten 'brel dge ba'i mtshan ma bzang po de la thams cad ngo mtshar skyes shing / bla ma yang thugs shin tu mnyes te dgyes pa byung ngo //deng dus su bkra shis pa'i gtsug lag khang mdzes shing bkod legs pa dang / sku gsung thags kyi rten dpe mdzod khang chos skyong gi rten khang ༄bcas bsod nams kyi zhing dang dad pa'i rten dge legs kyi dpal mang du bskrun par mdzad cing / grwa tshang gi bzhugs gnas khang khyim brgya phrag mang po dang bcas phyogs kun tu spang la me tog bkra ba bzhin ngo mtshar ba'i bkod pa rgya mtsho lta bu tshal du dngar ba la/ rgyal phyi nang gi skye dgu du mas dad spro mos 'dun gzhal du med pa'i ngang lhag bsam rnam dag gi phyag mchod bcas gtsug gi cod paṇa gyis gtugs te bsngags brjod kyi me tog sil ma 'bul bzhin pa lags so//de ltar chos sde chen po bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling zhes mtshan snyan gyi grags pa lha'i rnga bo che'i sgra dbyangs phyogs kun tu ldir zhing khyab pa ltar grags pa don mthun du mchis te/ rje nyid nas li khri'i rdul mang brtsegs pa'i lhun po bzhin ngur smrig 'dzin pa 'dus sde gtsang ma rgya mtsho lta bu la skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa tshang la ma nor ba blo rim 60

mkhan chen chos kyi grag sa pa 'i rto gas ba rjo da/ dang bstun te rgyun du 'chad par mdzad pas mang du thos pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa mang du byung / de yang 'dir cung zad gsal bar spros na/dus yun mi ring ba zhig gi nang 'khor du sku dngos kyi zhal slob bgrang las 'das pa zhig skyed bsrings te/ mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan gyis phyug pa mang du 'phel te rgyal bstan bshad sgrub kyis 'dzin pa'i chos sde du ma gsar du bskrun pa sogs yang slob mtha' yas pa dbyar gyi chu gter bzhin 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung zhing rgyas par gyar pa de/ chos rje dam pa khong gi thags bskyed dang phrin las kyi ༄༄ ra ba'ajug pa ni zad mi shes pa'i gter la 'gran pa ste co 'dri ba'i khyad par gyi mdzad pa'i che bar nges so/ /de yang ji skad du/ yon tan ldan na skye bo kun/ /ma bsdus par yang rang nyid 'du/ /dri ldan me tog rgyang ring yang / /bung ba sprin gyi tshogs bzhin 'khor/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mdo dbus khams gsum gyi blo ldan chos rnam dag don du gnyer ba'i slob tshogs mtha' yas pa'i khrod nas dngos slob kyi thu bor gyur pa rdzogs chen rgyal tshab mkhan sprul rdo rje bkra shis/ li thang mkhan po bsod nams rgya mtsho/ rgyal rong mkhan po gzhan phan chos kyi nyi ma/ mkhan po bkra shis don 'grub/ koḥthog mchog sprul karma 'jam dpal shes rab rgyal mtshan/ shar rgyal rong pa mkhan po thar 'bum/ mkhan sprul 'brug grags rgya mtsho/ brag mkhar mkhan po a thub/ ra lu'i bla ma tshe dpal/ khog tha mkhan po snyan grags/ bla ma 61

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs ba rjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / blo rgyam/ li thang mkhan po bsod nams chos 'phel/ koḥthog mchog sprul kun bzang / mkhan po mdo sngags/ sprul sku tshe ring bkra shis/'go log mkhan po pad+ma byang chub/ mkhan po shes rab rgya mtsho bcas bu slob mtha' yas pa 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur pa lags so/ /gzhan yang / mkhan chen gyi mdun du yun ring du nye gnas su zhugs pa'i zhabs tog pa ni/ sku tsha pad blo dang / bsod nams rgya mtsho/ bsod nams dar rgyas/ 'jigs med chos dbyings/ lha 'bum bcas yin la/de ltar chos rje dam pa mchog gi mdzad pa'i rnam par thar pa las/mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi mdzad pa bdag gir bzhes pa'i tshul ni gong du rags bsdus tsam smos zin la/ btsun pa'i tshal ༄mnga' ba yang / dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i gsol bzhi las kyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa bzhes te ltung ba sde lnga sogs dang rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba'i nyes ltung phra mos kyang ma gos par thugs rgyud rnam par dag cing / sgrub pa'i bslab bya gzhi bcu bdun gyi skabs nas ji ltar bstan pa bzhin lag len phyag tu bstar bas so sor thar pa'i tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs te bstan pa'i nang mdzod dam chos 'dul ba'i sde snod 'dzin pa'i mchog tu gyur/ de tsam gyis kyang chog shes par ma mdzad par/ rdzogs chen yid bzhin nor bu sku phreng drug pa'i yab chen ngag dbang nor bu rin po che'i sku drung nas/ zab mo lta srol gyi byang chub kyi sems sdom dang / mkhan 62

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rto gas ba rjo da/ rin po che 'jigs med yon tan mgon po las rgya chen spyod srol gyi byang chub sems kyi 'bog chog mnos te 'gro ba lha dang bcas pas phyag bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad/ khyad par gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor du mtshan nyid ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon du ma las/ dbang bzhi mtha' dang bcas pas thags rgyud yongs su smin par gyar te/ dbang srog dam ri ca ri ring ///sgotshig gi rim pa phra mo tshun chad nas ma nyams par bsrungs shing / d+ngha dang khyad par lhag pa'i dam tshig rnams rgyud nas ji ltar bstan pa bzhin dgag sgrub phra zhing phra ba nas spang blang mtha' dag phyag len la thebs par mdzad do/ /mdor na bdag nyid chen po 'di la ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid ma lus pa yongs su rdzogs pa ma tshang ba med pa zhig tu nges te/ mdo sde sum brgya pa las/ tshul khrims ldan zhing 'dul ba'i cho ga shes/ /nad par snying brtse 'khor ni dag pa dang //chos dang zang zing phan 'dogs brtson pa dang / /dus su 'doms pa de ltar bla mar bsngags/ /zhes pa ltar sdom pa gsum gyi tshul khrims rnam par dag pas thugs rgyud mdzes shing / mang du thos pa'i sde snod mtha' dag mkhyen pas 'dul ba'i cho ga la mkhas pa dang / mi gzhi bzang zhing thugs byams brtse dang ldan pas gdul bya mchog dman su yang rung ste chos dang zang zing gis rgyun du skyong ba dang / gzhung dang man ngag sogs kyi gdams pa yang sku tshegs la mi 'dzem par dus 63

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtog sa brjo da dang ga su nga rtsom / dang dus su 'doms par mdzad cing / nye gnas sogs sku 'khor rnams kyang tshul khrims rnam par dag cing rgyu 'bras la zhib pa/ blo khog yangs shing lugs gnyis gang yang mkhyen dpyod rab dang phul du byung ba mnga' bas/ mdo las gsungs pa'i bla ma'i mtshan nyid kyi zur phra mo'ang ma tshang ba med pa ste/ nga mgon po klu sgrub zhabs kyis/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen de dag gi /mtshan nyid mdor bsdus mkhyen par mdzod/ /chog shes snying rje khrims ldan pa/ /nyon mongs sel ba'i shes rab can/ /de dag la ni khyod brten na/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / rje btsun byams pas/ bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba/ /yon tan lhag pa brtson bcas lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs pa smra mkhas ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ba spangs la bsten/ /zhes shing rta rnam gnyis kyis gsungs pa'i bla ma'i mtshan nyid rnams kyang yongs su tshang zhing / khyad par du rgyud las/ ston pa mdzod ldan chu bo rdzogs//gnyer ldan rgyud dang las la mkhas/ /man ngag drod dang brgyad 'chang ba/ /gsang sngags bla ma'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid kyang ldan te/ lta spyod ting 'dzin gsam gyi mdzod ༄dang ldan zhing / dbang bzhi'i chu bo yongs su rdzogs pa/ gdams ngag gi gnyer kha dang ldan zhing / gzhi lam 'bras bu'i don la mkhas pa/zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las rab 'byams la byang zhing man ngag gi drod tshad brnyes pa ste mtshan nyid brgyad dang ldan la/ khyad par du yang lta 64

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjod/ ba'i phu thag chod/ sgom pa klong du gyur/ spyod pa tshad du phyin/ rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol/ thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba sogs 'brel tshad don ldan gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas dngos dang mnyam pa 'di 'dra ba ni deng dus snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i skabs su ma zad sngon dus su'ang dkon par snang ngo / /gzhan yang rje 'di nyid la sgrub pa'i yon tan rmad du byung ba mnga' ba'i rnam par thar pa yang mang du mchis la/ spyir nges 'byung gi bsam pa byang chub kyi sems/ yang dag pa'i lta ba rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor/ bslab gsum gyi nyams len sogs kyang grub pa'i yon tan mchog yin par sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis bzhed la/ de lta mod kyang deng dus su mngon shes 'chad pa/ rdzu 'phrul ston pa/ 'phral rkyen bsam pa/ 'dre gdon 'dul ba/ mig 'phrul ston pa sogs tho co'i spyod pa kho na la grub rtags ches ya mtshan du brtsi ba'i blun dad col chung rgyu mtshan mi shes pa shin tu mang bas/grub thob zer ba de gang la ngos 'dzin rgyu yin tsam yang shes mkhan dkon par snang ngo / /spyir grub thob ces pa'i nges tshig kyang / bslab gsum dang rim gnyis sogs nang gi mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan khyad par can thugs rgyud la grub cing gzhan du mi 'gyur bar brtan pa thob pa nyid la bya zhes tshad ldan gyi gsung rab dag las bshad do/ /de las mngon shes 'chad pa dang rdzu 'phrul ston pa rdo la phyag zhabs kyi rjes btod pa sogs kyang grub pa thob pa'i lag rjes su gyar mod/sto65

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / 'on kyang de kho na la grub pa'i rtags zhes zhen par bya mi rigs te/ de dag thun mong gi grub pa yin pas mi stegs la sogs pa'ang yod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dam pa 'di nyid ni sku tshe hril por bslab gsam gyi ༄nyams len dang rim gnyis kyi ting 'dzin sa lam gyi spang rtogs sogs la nyams len gyi mthar mdzad cing mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan thugs rgyud la 'khrungs te brtan pa thob phyir/ grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi mchog tu gyur pa'i tshul sogs ni dpyod ldan rnams kyis rtogs sla'o/ /spyir khong gis dus rgyun mkhas btsun bzang po'i rnam thar kho nas rgyal bstan 'dzin skyong spel ba'i thabs 'ba' zhig gtso bor mdzad pa las/ mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul sogs phra mo tsam yang ched du gnang ba'i srol med mod/ de lta na'ang 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyis/ dam pa'i yon tan sbas gyur kyang / /'jig rten kun la khyab par gsal/ /sna ma'i me tog bkab na yang / /dri zhim kun la khyab par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rje 'di nyid ni thugs sgam zhing zhal btsun pa'i stabs kyis yon tan phra rags gang ci yang rung shin tu gsang ba'i tshul gyis nam yang mi mngon par mdzad kyang /rang shugs kyis 'gog mi nus shing gsang mi tshugs pa'i ring grub pa'i lag rjes thor bu re gong du gzhung dngos kyi skabs su smos pa rnams ni lo rgyus kyi gtam drang por bshad pa'i shugs 'byung du 'ong ba rnams btang snyoms su ma bzhag par rjes 'jug rnams dad pa 'phel ba'i 66

mkhan chen chos kyi grag sa pa 'i rto gas ba rjo da/ slad du dmigs te bkod pa'o/ /slar yang rje bla ma'i sku tshe stod smad bar gsum kun tu legs par mdzad pa'i phyag bzhes yang rjes 'jug skye bo'i nyams len la gal che bar bsam te phyogs tsam 'god par bya ba la/ de yang nangs par shin tu snga bar bzhengs te mar me dang / chu mchod sogs mchod pa rgya cher bshams la sgrol ma'i maṇ+ḍal bzhi chog dang / sman mdo yid bzhin dbang rgyal sogs thugs nas gsung bzhin/ phyag stong phrag gcig dang bdun brgya tsam 'tshal zhing mthar dge bsngo smon lam ci rigs mdzad rjes/ nye gnas nas gsol ja drangs pa myur mos bzhes 'phral dri med bshags rgyud dang sbol nas phyag lnga brgya tsam btsal te zhal 'don gyi skor mang por ljags bzlas mdzad/ skabs 'dir dpe khrid yod tshe gnang zhing / med na dpe gzigs sogs chags med rgyun du mdzad/ gung tshig gi rjes phyi thun bcad de rgyun ring bzhugs/ phyi dro chags med bde smon dang bzang spyod smon lam sogs dz+rel nas phyag sam brgya re 'tshal te nyin gcig ༄la phyag nyis stong lnga brgya re chags med mdzad/ de rjes gsur bsngo dang gshin bsngo sogs gsungs nas 'brel thogs yongs la dmigs te bsngo smon zab rgyas gnang / bar skabs su sats+tsha dang lha sku grangs mang phyag 'debs mdzad/ gzhan nad pa sogs la sman bcos dang gshin po la 'pho ba/ mjal kha len mi so sor chos 'brel gang 'os gnang ste re ba bskang / de dag sku tshe stod phyogs te sku ha cang ma 67

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtog sa brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / bgres pa'i gnas skabs rnams su mtshon te smras pa'o/ /gzhan yang rab byung stong lhag tsam bsgrubs pa dang / lo re re tshogs 'khor 'bum phrag mar me 'bum phrag chu mchod bye ba phyag bye ba/ sats+tsha lha sku 'bum ther btab pa sogs nye gnas dag gis dma' rtsis mdzad pa'i tho 'god las bshus pa ste mdor na dam pa 'di nyid rtag par dge sbyor 'ba' zhig gis dus kyi skar cha tsam yang chud gron med pa'i skyes chen zhig go/sa bcad gsum pa/ dge rtsa bla med byang chub tu bsngo zhing smon lam gyi rgyas gdab cing bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis mtha' brgyan pa/slar smras pa/rje btsun gang nyid nges pa lnga ldan gyi/ /zung 'jug sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar gyis/ /gsang chen rdo rje snying po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /mtha' klas dag pa'i gdul bya smin par mdzad/ /brgyud gsum bla ma'i byin rlabs chu bo'i rgyun/ /las can skye bo'i 'dzin mar yongs 'phos par/ /sku gsum lha yi phrin las rgyu skar tshogs/ /rnam pa ma 'dres mngon sum cig car bkra/ /68

mkhan chen chos kyi gra ga sa pa 'i rto gas ba rjod / gang sku 'jigs bral mi shigs rdo rje'i chos/ /mtshan dpe zla gzhon gsal ba'i 'od snang can/ /dwangs ma'i mtsho la shar ba'i bzhin ris ltar/ /mi nyag sa yi thig ler 'tsho zhing gzhes/ /birlus zhag bdun nyi ma stod bzung bzhin/ /dus kyi mtha' 'dir thub bstan nyin mo'i mgon/ /brel ba'i tshal gyis nub ri'i rtser son tshe/ /༄khyod kyis mkhas btsun bzang po'i brtul zhugs la/ /brten nas lung rigs 'phrul gyi zhags pa yis/ /'chor med dam du 'dzin pa'i shugs bskyed nas/ /rgyal bstan rin chen rdzogs ldan dpal du bskrun/ /khyod ni nyi ma'i gnyen gyi zla bor snyems/ /khams zhes grags pa nor 'dzin yangs pa'i ltor/ /rab 'byams lung rigs smra ba'i chos kyi grwa/ /mdo sngags rig gzhung rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas che/ /thub bstan bshad sgrub dar rgyas chos gling zhes/ /thos bsam rin chen nor bu'i tshong brdal du/ /pad+ma'i tshal la bung ba'i 'du 'god bzhin/ /skal bzang skye bor chos kyi rnyed pa thob/ /na len+d+ra yi dpal la 'khu snyam spro/ /69

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtsom / gur gum gsar ba'i tshal la co 'dri ba'i/ /rab 'byams ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i chos kyi grwar/ /zab dang rgya che'i legs bshad bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /da dung ci dgar rol ba'i las la brel/ /byang chub sems ldan rim gnyis ting 'dzin la/ /g.yel ba med par mdo sngags gzhung brgya yi/ /gtan pa med pa'i chos sbyin 'dzad med gter/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i tshogs la snyom par 'gyed/ /bgrang yas phyag mchod ga ṇa tsakra dang / /nyam thag 'gro la skyabs kyi sbyin pa sogs/ /'phags pa dgyes pa'i mchod sprin nam mkha'i mdzod/ /chu bo'i rgyun bzhin drag tu lhur bzhes mdzad/ /de las gzhan mang rje 'di yis/ /bya ba las kyi 'khor lo ni/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis ston mdzad pa/ /mtha' dag gzhal bar dka' na yang / /'jigs med zhi ba'i grong khyer du/ /rin chen mdzes pa'i gharnyo la/ /gtsug lag nor bu'i ba gam can/ /bde gshegs sku yi snang brnyan dang / /70

mkhan chen chos kyi grag sa pa 'i rto gas ba rjo da/ thub pa'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel gyi/ /glegs bam ri bo'i mthongs la snyegs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod sdong che/ /grangs med pa yi rgyan du bkod/ /gzhan yang dad ldan pho mo ni/ /bye ma'i grangs bzhin gdul bya la/ /'pho ba ma bsgom sangs rgyas sogs/ /gzhan phan chos kyis rjes 'dzin mdzad/ /mdor na dpal ldan bla ma gang / /chos kyi 'khor sgyur chen po ste/ /don gnyis mdzad pa'i cha tsam yang / /bskal par brjod kyang mtha' mi rdzogs/ /de lta na'ang rje btsun gang nyid kyi/ /gsang gsum rmad byung rtogs pa brjod pa'i gtam/ /cha shas tsam zhig yi ge'i lam du byas/ /'gal dang nongs pa ci mchis bzod par gsol/ /'dis mtshon dus gsam bsags pa'i dge ba yis/ /༄pha ma'i thog drangs mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i tshogs/ /ma lus kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang che/ /bde blag nyid du thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /71

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / khyad par rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/ /mi nub phyogs dus dar zhing rgyas pa dang / /bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan thugs kyi bzhed don kun/ /'bad med lhun gyis 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /bdag kyang 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /mchog gsum lha yi thags rje'i snang ba dang / /༄'bral med thub bstan chos kyi rgyal srid la/ /rang dbang sgyur ba'i skal ba mchog thob shog /sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhi ba chags bral dam chos rin chen mdzod/ /rgyal sras dpa' bo rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs/ /dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyi bkra shis shog /byin rlabs rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid bla ma rje/ /dngos grub bye ba'i 'byung gnas yi dam lha/ /bar chad kun sel gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog /'chi med grub pa'i dpal mnga' rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rigs gsum mgon sogs rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i mthus/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs pad rtag brtan te/ /phrin las sa gsum khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /72

mkhan chen chos kyi grag sa pa 'i rto gas ba rjo da/ mchog gsum bla ma'i thugs rje byin mthu dang / /chos nyid rgyu 'bras bslu med bden stobs kyis/ /rnam dag smon pa'i ngag la byin zhugs te/ /gegs med yid bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shig shog /ces chos rje bla ma mchog gi rtogs pa brjod pa nyung ngur gleng ba 'di yang lung dang rigs pa'i dbang phyug sde snod 'dzin pa mkhan 'brug grags rgya mtsho mchog gis bka' phebs nan po zlog tu ma spobs shing / gzhan yang rje bla ma'i nye gnas sku tsha pad+ma theg mchog blo ldan zhal snga nas kyang mkhan rin po che'i rnam thar zhig 'bri rtsom dgos tshul gyis gsung shog kyang lag tu 'byor zhing / nye char sprul pa'i sku mchog mthar phyin nas bri gzhi dang zhu dag sogs kyi grogs bgyis te/mkhan 'brug dga' mchog gis dpyad gzhi 'tshol sdud dang dpe skrun bgyid par zhal bzhes mdzad cing / nyid kyis brtsams gnang mdzad pa'i mkhan rin po che'i mdzad rnam mdor bsdus zhes pa kho nar gzhi bcol zhing ngag sgros gtsang ma 'ga' zhig gis zur brgyan te sug bris su bgyid pa po ni btsun gzugs rmongs rtul bsod nams nyi mar 'bod pa des skyabs rje rdo grub rin po che'i gdan sa rdzi med bkra legs kyi yang dben ri khrod lha yi dga' tshal du/ blo gsal gyi slob bu du mar mkhas 'jug dang spyod 'jug sogs kyi bshad pa bgyi ba'i zhar la ngal ba khur du blangs te rab rgyan me glang lo'i tha skar zla ba'i gza' 73
( rtogs brjoḥ/ra dam— zhing bskang

mkhan chen thub bstan chos kyi grags pa'i rnam tha ra snying ba sdu sa/ ༄7/ /mi nyag mkhan chen thub bstan chos kyi grags pa'i rnam thar snying bsdus gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so//da mi nyag thub bstan chos dar kyis brtsams/bskal mang gong nas srid zhir mi gnas gdod ma'i rgyal sar bzhugs mod kyang / /'gag med thugs kyi klong nas snying rje chu 'dzin stug po rab 'khrigs pas/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i sbrang char gdul bya'i khams la rtag khyab 'bebs mdzad pa'i/ /khams gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po skyabs rje bla mas rtag tu bdag srungs shig /so skyes bdag 'drar rnam thar 'bri ba'i mtshan nyid mi ldan mod/ /'on kyang 'jig rten mig gcig mtshangs med bla ma rin po che'i/ /bka' drin dran ༄pa'i gsos su smin phyir phyi rnam mdo tsam zhig /sgo gsum dad pa'i shing rtar bskyon de ci nus 'bri bar bya//thog mar rnam thar 'di khungs gang la bcol nas bkod ce na/gtso bo mkhan bsod nams nyi mas mdzad pa'i chos rje dam pa mkhan rin po che dharma kin+ti'i rnam par thar pa ma bcos lhug pa'i rtogs brjod rdzogs ldan dpyid kyi dpal yon/ zhes bya ba'i rnam thar de la gzhi byas shing / mkhan rin po che'i zhabs drung du mi lo sum cu lhag gi 75

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjod dang ga su nga rtso ma / ring la bzhugs pa'i mkhan bkra shis don 'grub dang / gzhan yang khong gi thugs sras slob chen rnams dang nye gnas sogs la bka' 'dri yang yang byas nas bkod pa'o// mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal pos sku tshe hril por bstan pa dang sems can gyi don kho na mdzad nas bzhugs pa yin pas phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab pa brjod du yod la/ 'dir yongs su grags pa'i mdzad pa rnams mdor bsdus te 'jig rten pa'i blo dang 'tshams pa zhig bkod pa yin no//dang po/ rigs rus dang sku 'khrungs pa'i dus/skyabs rje mkhan chen rin po che mchog ni rigs bzang pha yab dge legs dang skyon bral ma yum rtswa ra rdo rje bzang mo gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bco lnga pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo 1916)lo'i bod zla drug pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma bcas te sku 'khrungs/ de'ang sku lhums su zhugs pa'i dus phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin der nam mkha'i khams nas dar dkar po dri ma med pa zhig yum gyi khyim du bab pa dang /chu zangs dkar gang de 'o mar gyur nas yod pa sogs kyi rtags mtshan khyad par can mang du byung / sku 'khrungs pa'i dus bzang gi nyin der yul phyogs 'di'i gnas ri grags can dpal ri mtsho bdun dang ri bdun zhes 'bod pa'i ya gyal mtsho shis brtan ma zer ba las g.yu 'brug bdun dus gcig la nam mkhar song ba dang / bar snang 76

mkhan chen thub bstan chos kyi grags pa'i rnam tha ra snying ba sdu sa / gi khams thams cad 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang phub pa sogs ngo mtshar pa'i rtags mtshan bsam gyis mi khyab pa du ma byung ba kun gyis mngon sam du mthong yod do// sku 'khrungs pa'i gnas ni bod gangs can gyi ༄ljongs chen po 'di la stod na mnga' ris skor gsum dang / bar na dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad na mdo khams sgang drug ces rlung ltar grags pa las smad mdo khams sgang drug gi ya gyal mi nyag ra ba sgang gi char gtogs 'ba' lha sgang gi yul gru nang skor dgu 'brug sum mdo zhes bya ba'i gnas der sku 'khrungs so// deng skabs gnas 'di dkar mdzes khul dar mdo rdzong lha sgang grong nang skor sde ba'i yul du khel yod do//gnyis pa/ byis pa'i dus kyi mdzad spyod/khong sku na shin tu gzhon pa'i dus nas byis pa gzhan dang mi 'dra ba ya rabs kyi spyod pa kho na la gnas pa/ snying rje dang shes rab che ba/rnam dkar gyi las la spro ba/ rten gsum dang bla ser sogs mthong na thugs shin tu dgyes shing dad 'dun dang dag snang ngang gis yod pa/rtsed mo gnang skabs gtsug lag khang bzheng pa dang / sgom sgrub byed pa/chos 'chad nyan gyi rnam pa kho na mdzad cing / byis pa'i dus nas mkhyen pa dang mthong snang mi 'dra ba'ang mang du mnga' ste/ de'ang nyin gcig rdzi bor phebs pa'i skabs phyi khung zhig gi nang na shel rdo dkar 77

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / ser dmar ljang bsam gyis mi khyab pa mang po zhig gzigs shing / phyi nyin slar yang lta ru byon tshe shul tsam yang med pa'o/ /rdzi bo 'gro skabs sats+tsha khang sogs sa 'thor yod pa'i shog lha rnams bsdus/ rdo yi khri ༄khang 'dra ba brtsigs/ de'i nang du shog lha rnams legs par sbyar te gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab nas bsgoms pas shog lha rnams shig shig yom yom du 'gul ba byung gsungs pa'o/ /rgyun du rdzi bor phebs pa'i gnas nyi khug lung pa zhes bya ba'i lung pa der brag ri zhig yod pa de la khong gis gzhung bka' pod lnga sogs kyi chos brtsigs shig yin pa'i mthong snang dngos su shar/ khong gis brag ri de la phyag mdzub gtad de rdzi grogs rnams la 'di mngon pa yin/ 'di dbu ma yin/ 'di phar phyin yin/ 'di 'dul ba yin zhes brda sprad kyang rdzi grogs rnams la brda 'phrod thub pa ci yang ma byung gsungs/ dus phyis mkhan rin po che khong gis slob tshogs rnams khrid nas brag ri de la lta mjal yang yang phebs pa'o/ /brag zhabs pa zhes pa'i khyim tshang zhig tu gshin chog la byon dus/ nyin gcig ja skabs shig na bla ma rdo rje tshe ring khong gis sngon chad rdzogs chen gzhan phan chos kyi snang ba'i zhabs drung nas dbu ma sogs dam pa'i chos gsan tshul gyi zhal ta gnang skabs der mkhan rin po ches dbu ma zhes pa'i tshig de gsan ma thag tu sngon gyi bag chags sad de sems gting nas dad pa tshad med pa zhig skyes nas spyan chab dbang med du shor te sdod mi tshugs pa lta bu byung / bla 78

mkhan chen thub bstan chos kyi grags pa 'i rnam tha ra snying ba sdu sa/ grwa rnams kyis khong gi spyan chab shor ba'i rgyu mtshan ma shes pas ma gir grwa phrug de la ltos dang rgyu mtshan med par ci la ngu zer nas kun gyis 'phya smod byas/ mkhan rin po che khong la byis pa'i dus nas gzigs snang mi 'dra ba yod pa'i rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab par brjod rgyu yod mod/ 'dir yig tshogs mang du dogs nas dpe brjod tsam las ma bkod do// khong dgung grangs bdun la slebs skabs mi nyag kun bzang bsod nams kyi nye gnas bla ma a dpal gyi sku drung nas yi ge klog sbyang mdzad/ 'on kyang khong gi khyim gyi 'tsho ba shin tu dbal ba'i ༄rkyen gyis dgung lo brgyad pa'i steng phyugs rdzi sogs gzhan gyi gnas la gla ba byon dgos pa byung / de nas gla ba mdzad zhor yi ge klog sbyang gnang bas tshegs med du mkhyen/ ma zad khong gi gsung skad rab tu snyan cing sgrung dang gtam rgyud sogs klog pa la shin tu mkhas pa yod pas/ yul sde'i mi rgan rnams kyis khong la gla rngan phran bu phul nas sgrung yig dang gtam rgyud klog 'jug pa'o// dgung lo bcu pa'i thog brag mkhar dgon pa'i hor bla a khyug mchog gis khong la gsol chas dang mnab bza' bcas 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen gnang / ma zad dgon pa'i 'don cha dang bca' rdung 'bud gsum sogs legs par bslab pas tshegs med du mkhyen nas dge rgan thugs mnyes nas bstod bsngags yang yang mdzad/ de nas brag mkhar dgon pa'i grwa ba mdzad/ cho ga dang gdangs dbyangs bcas la mkhas pa'i tshad du grags pa'o//79

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjod dang ga su nga rtsom / dgung grangs bcu gsum bzhes pa'i skabs su mdo rin po che khams gsum zil gnon dgyes pa rdo rje brag mkhar dgon du phebs nas khrid yig kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung dang / khrid yig ye shes bla ma gsungs/ khong gis mdo rin po che'i gsungs pa rnams ma yum dang chos grogs rnams la bshad pas kun kyang ngo mtshar bar gyur nas 'di 'dra ba'i byis pa shes rab can zhes bstod bsngags rgya cher thob de nas khong gis mdo rin po che la rgyun du gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pas/ nyin gcig gzim khang gi rtsig pa'i ngor mdo rin po che'i dbu la paṇa zhwa gsol ba zhig mngon sum du zhal mjal byung ba'o// da dung byis pa'i gnas skabs kyi rnam thar mang du brjod rgyu yod la/ 'dir mdor bsdus pa tsam las ma smos so//gsum pa/ skyes chen rnams kyis sprul sku'i mtshan gsol tshul/khong sku na phra ba'i dus su bā+oḥganas sku chen dpa' bo nyi ma 'od zer dang / sku chung rig 'dzin 'gyar med rnam gnyis kyis skyes bu stochen po tsha nyag bla ma shes rab kyi sku skye yin pa ngos 'dzin mdzad de bā:gnas dgon du spyan drangs pa'o// phyis su 'khor gdong sprul ba'i sku 'gyur med rdo rje mchog gis 'khor gdong dgon du mkhan por gdan drangs/ skyes bu chen po shes rab me 'bar gyi yang srid yin pa 80

mkhan chen thub bstan chos kyi grags pa 'i rnam tha ra snying ba sdu sa/ ngos 'dzin mdzad/ rten gsum dang / mchod chas/ mnab bza'/ bla brang / rta drel sogs nor rdzas gya nom pa mang du phul/ sprul sku'i mtshan dang / 'khor gdong dgon pa'i bstan pa'i 'gan bzhes dgos pa'i bka' nan yang yang phab/ 'on kyang mkhan rin po ches dgon pa'i bya ba phal che ba 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi dbang dang /thos bsam dang 'chad nyan gyi gegs su 'gro nyen che bar gzigs nas zhal bzhes ma gnang ba'o// gzhan yang byis pa'i dus su brag mkhar bla ma kun bzang mchog gis mi nyag kun bzang bsod nams sam thub bstan chos kyi grags pa'i sku'i rnam 'phrul yin pa ngos 'dzin gnang /bla ma a dpal gyis mi nyag kun bzang bsod nams kyi gdan sa be lo ri khrod du gdan drangs/ mi nyag kun bzang bsod nams kyi phyag dpe dang mchod rdzas rnams khong la phul/ klog bslab/ thugs brtse rgya cher mdzad do// mkhan rin po che nyid kyi zhal nas/ mi nyag mkhas pa mi lnga'i ya gyal bka' bzhi pa rigs pa'i seng ge de nyid smad mi nyag gi phyogs su dge slong gi skye ba bcu gsum bzhes te bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya cher mdzad la/ de'i skye phreng gnyis pa mi nyag kun bzang bsod nams yin tshul gsungs nas/ skye phreng gsum pa mkhan rang nyid yin pa lta bu shugs la zhal gyis bzhes/ mi nyag kun bzang bsod nams kyi gsang spyi dang bye brag tu spyod 'jug 'grel chen la ༄'chad spel thengs sum cu lhag gnang zhing / ma zad rgyun du slob bu 81

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / rnams la mi nyag kun bzang bsod nams kyi rtogs brjod dang rnam thar zhib phra gsungs/ de'i phyir yongs grags kyis mi nyag kun bzang bsod nams kyi rnam sprul yin par 'dod/ 'on kyang mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal pos sprul sku'i mtshan dang sprul sku'i go sar thugs mi dgyes pas gtan nas ma bzhes so//bzhi pa/ sdom pa gsum gyi rgyun bzhes tshul/dgung lo bco lnga'i thog mi nyag brag mkhar dgon nas mkhas btsan gyi yon tan mnga' ba'i khri rgan bla ma rdo rje tshe ring gis mkhan po ༄dang / gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa tshe ring rdo rjes las kyi slob dpon mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang gi zhal snga nas rab byung gi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan thub bstan grags pa 'od zer zhes gsol/dgung lo nyi shu'i thog rdzogs chen shrī seng chos grwa chen mo nas bslab gsum nor bu'i mdzod 'chang ba'i a bu lha sgang ngam mkhan chen pad+ma theg mchog blo ldan gyis mkhan po dang / mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan dang ldan pa'i gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po mkhan po thub snyan nam mkhan chen thub bstan snyan grags kyis las kyi slob dpon/ gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po mkhan po mgon ris sam 'jigs med yon tan mgon pos gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon/gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po mkhan chen pad+ma tshe dbang gis 82

mkhan chen thub bstan chos kyi grags pa 'i rnam tha ra snying ba sdu sa / dus go ston pa'i slob dpon/ mkhan po 'jigs med bsam gtan sogs kyis kha skong gi mkhan po mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang gi zhal snga nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan thub bstan grags pa 'od zer zhes gsol/ de nas dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i bca' khrims rnams tshul bzhin du bsrungs bas gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po'i khri la mnga' dbang 'byor ba'o// byang sdom ni mkhan po ngag dbang nor bu'i sku drung nas zab mo lta ba'i lugs kyi byang chub sems kyi sdom pa bzhes/ mkhan chen 'jigs med yon tan mgon po'i zhabs drung nas rgya chen spyod pa'i lugs kyi byang chub sems kyi sdom pa bzhes/ de nas byang chub sems dpa'i bslab sdom rnams tshul bzhin du bsrangs shing bslab pas rgyal sras byang chub sems ༄dpa'i rgyal srid la mnga' dbang 'byor ba'o// gsang sngags kyi sdom pa ni/ rdzogs chen rin po che thub bstan chos kyi rdo rje dang / zhe chen kong sprul pad+ma dri med legs pa'i blo gros sogs mtshan ldan gyi rdo rje slob dpon du ma'i zhabs drung nas snga 'gyur yo ga gsum sogs rgyud sde rnams kyi dbang bzhi legs par bzhes shing / gzhan yang gsar phyogs kyi skyes chen rnams kyi mdun nas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang du ma'ang bzhes/ de nas gsang sngags kyi dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du bsrungs bas gsang sngags rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtan srid la mnga' dbang 'byor ba'o//83

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtsom / lnga pa/ grwa sar byon nas thos bsam dang dbang lung gi rgyun bzhes tshul/mkhan rin po che dgung grangs bco brgyad bzhes skabs snga 'gyur rnying ma'i gdan sa chen po rdzogs chen dang / zhe chen sogs su grwa sar phebs/ thog mar rdzogs chen shrī seng nas mkhan chen thub bstan snyan grags bsten te rgyal sras lag len gyi rtsa 'grel/ mkhas grub rje'i stong than/ sdom gsum rnam nges kyi mchan 'grel sogs gzhung mang po la ༄gsan bsam gnang / mkhan po thub snyan gyis zhal nas/ bu chung skya tho de rig pa tsha po 'dug de la skyor dpon byed du chug gsungs/ grwa sar zhugs ma thag tu skyor dpon gyi go sa thob/ shes rab shin tu che bas mi nyag chos grags kyi rig pa lta bu zhes kun la grags pa byung / mkhan chen ngag dbang nor bu'i zhabs drung nas spyod 'jug gi 'grel pa/mngon pa mchan 'grel/ mngon pa mchims chen/ mngon pa mchims chung / gzhan dga'i sher phyin mchan 'grel/ dpal sprul gyi sher phyin spyi don dang 'bru 'grel/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po'i 'grel chung don gsal sogs phar phyin dang mngon pa'i skor mang du gsan sbyong mdzad/ khong gis spyod 'jug gsan skabs spyod 'jug gi tshig don rnams la mi shes pa zhig yod pa thugs la ma shar/ mched grogs rnams kyis spyod 'jug mi shes zer nas yang yang gzigs kyin yod pa 84

mkhan chen thub bstan chos kyi grags pa 'i rnam tha ra snying ba sdu sa / la kho tshos ci zhig mi shes pa yin snyam nas khong ngo mtshar skyes byung gsungs/ /mkhan chen pad+ma tshe dbang gi sku drung nas go rams pa'i sher phyin sbas don zab mo gter gyi kha 'byed dang / phar phyin gyi mtha' dpyad yum don rab gsal/ phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid sbas don rab gsal/ dge 'dun nyi shu'i rnam bshad/ rten 'brel gyi rnam bshad/bsam gzugs kyi rnam bshad/ mi nyag kun bzang bsod nams kyi chos 'khor gyi rnam bshad/ 'jam mgon mi pham pa'i tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi 'grel pa sogs phar phyin dang tshad ma'i chos skor la thos bsam zab rgyas gnang / gzhung spyi'i go don dang / dka' gnad/mtshan nyid rnams thugs la zin par mdzad pa'o//bslab gsum nor bu'i mdzod 'chang mkhan po bsod rgyal lam bsod nams dbang rgyal gyi zhal snga nas dbu ma 'jug pa'i 'grel pa sogs dbu ma'i chos skor la gsan bsam rgya cher mdzad/ dbu ma'i dka' gnad rnams thugs la chud/ dbu ma la mkhas pa mi nyag chos grags lta bu zhes snyan pa'i grags pa gangs ljongs 'dzin ma'i phyogs kun tu khyab/ mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po me ba mkhan po ye shes dar rgyas kyi zhabs drung nas 'jam mgon mi pham pa'i dbu ma rgyan gyi rnam bshad dang / brag dkar brgal lan nyin byed snang ba/ rab gsal brgal lan che chung sogs 'ju mi pham gyi gsang skor phal che ba'i bshad khrid dang lung rgyun bzhes so//༄85

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhan chen ngag dbang nor bu'i zhabs drung nas rgyal ba klong chen pa'i yid bzhin mdzod dang / gsang snying gi spyi don yid kyi man sel/ gsang snying gi tshig don phyogs bcu'i man sel/ gsang rib zu ri gi snying gi bsdus don ma rig mun sel/ smin gling lo chen gyi gsang snying gi 'grel pa gsang bdag dgongs rgyan dang / spyi don gsang bdag zhal lung sogs gsang snying gi chos skor la gsan bsam gting tshugs pa mdzad/ gzhan yang bde chen zhing khrid sogs khrid lung gi rgyun mang du bzhes/ sangs rgyas gtsug tor can mi'i rnam par byon pa'i rdzogs chen rin po che sku phreng lnga pa thub bstan chos kyi rdo rje'i zhabs drung nas zhi khro 'phrad tshad rang grol gyi dbang dang / gzhan yang snga 'gyur rnying ma'i zab chos du ma'i dbang lung khrid gsum sogs legs par thob/ bcos min gyi dad pa skyes/ thugs rgyud la byin rlabs zhugs/ sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes 'khrungs/ rdzogs chen rin po che'i sku phreng drug pa 'jigs bral byang chub rdo rje'i sku drung nas tshe dbang dang / gzhan yang rdzogs pa chen po'i chos skor sogs snga 'gyur rnying ma'i zab chos du ma'i dbang lung khrid gsum legs par thob/ 'brug pa sku chen chos dbyings rang grol gyi zhal snga nas rgyal ba klong chen pa'i bla ma yang tig dang / mkha' 'gro snying thig mkha' 'gro yang tig zab mo yang tig bi ma snying thig bcas kyi dbang lung yongs rdzogs dang / rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i zab 86

mkhan chen thub bstan chos kyi grags pa 'i rnam tha ra snying ba sdu sa / gter snying thig dum gnyis sogs gsung 'bum cha tshang gi dbang lung khrid gsum bzhes/ kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho'i rnam rol rdzogs chen kong sprul mchog gi zhabs drung nas rig 'dus ma hā gu ru dang / yum ka bde chen rgyal mo/ bde gshegs dpal chen 'dus pa ste snying thig rtsa gsum gyi dbang dang / gzhan yang snying thig gi chos skor du ma'i dbang lung khrid gsum sogs kyi rgyun bzhes/ mkhan chen 'jigs med yon tan mgon po'i zhabs drung nas mdo mkhyen brtse ye shes rdo rje'i 'dzin pa rang grol gyi dbang lung khrid gsum dang / chags med rā ka a sus kyi gcod sogs chos skor du ma'i dbang lung gi rgyun bzhes/ mkhan chen pad+ma theg mchog blo ldan gyi zhabs drung nas rgyal ba klong chen pa'i mdzod bdun dang / don khrid skor gsum/ rang grol skor gsum/ rgyab chos cha tshang dang / rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i sngon 'gro dran pa nyer bzhag dris lan sogs dang / dpal sprul 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po'i khrid yig kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung /'jam mgon mi pham pa'i bshags pa'i rgyal po rdo rje'i tshig bdun gyi 'grel pa pad+ma dkar po/ sngon 'gro thar lam rab gsal/ rdzogs skor bcas la bshad khrid/ tshig khrid/ dmar khrid/ bsdus khrid kyi sgo nas yun ring gi dus la thos bsam dang blo sbyong mdzad pas/ sgrib pa srab cing thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rtogs pa du ma rgyud la skyes/mkhan rin po che'i rtsa ba'i bla ma than mong ma yin pa zhe chen kong sprul ༄87

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs ba rjod dang ga su nga rtsom / pad+ma dri med legs pa'i blo gros kyi zhabs drung nas rdzogs pa chen po sems sde dang / klong sde/ man ngag gi sde bcas kyi zab khrid rnams dang / rdo rje gro lod kyi sgrub thabs/ hūṃ sgrub chen mo sogs zab rgyas kyi chos du ma'i dbang lung gdams khrid rnams legs par thob pas/rig pa ngo 'phrod/ rtog pa rang sar du grol/ skyes bu chen po'i rgyal sa la mnga' dbang thob/ mkhan po kun dga' dpal ldan gyi zhabs drung nas chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod/ tshig gsum gnad brdeg sogs man ngag gi chos mang du thob/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma'i zhal snga nas kyang chos dang rig gnas mang du gsan/mdor na grwa sa nas mi lo bcu drug gi ring la dka' spyad dang snying rus kyi sgo nas mkhas grub kyi skyes bu grangs las 'das pa'i zhabs la gtugs nas mdo sngags kyi chos rgya mtsho lta bu'i gnas la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs chod par mdzad pas/ mkhas dang grub pa'i rgyal sa thob/ grags snyan gyi rnga sgra phyogs kun tu khyab pa byung ba'o//drug pa/ 'chad nyan gyi sgo nas bstan pa rin po che spel tshul/1 'khor gdong dang g.yu khog dgon du byon pa'i skor/rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa byi (spyi lo1948)lor 'khor gdong sprul pa'i sku 'gyar med rdo rje mchog gis 'khor gdong dgon du mkhan ༄88

mkhan chen thub bstan chos kyi grags pa 'i rnam tha ra snying bsdu sa/ por spyan drangs/ sprul sku'i mtshan gsol/ bstan pa'i bdag por bskos/ mkhan rin po ches grwa pa brgya phrag lhag la dge tshal slong gi ༄sdom pa gnang / dbyar gnas gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ bshad grwa ba rnams la 'dul ba mdo rtsa dang / sdom gsum rnam nges kyi rtsa 'grel sogs 'dul ba'i skor dang / mngon pa mdzod dang / mngon pa kun btus sogs mngon pa'i skor/ dbu ma 'jug pa dang / spyod 'jug sogs dbu ma'i skor/ phar phyin mngon rtogs rgyan sogs phar phyin gyi skor sogs gzhung chen po rnams la bshad khrid rgya cher mdzad/ gzhan yang blo sbyong dang zhal gdams kyi skor/ bsnyen yig dang/ sgom rim sogs sgrub thabs kyi skor la mdzub khrid gnang bas/ mkhas grub kyi slob bu mang du byung / de nas g.yu khog bla ma rdo rjes g.yu khog dgon du spyan drangs/ bshad grwa'i mkhan po mdzad de grwa slob mang po la dge tshul slong gi sdom pa gnang / dbyar gnas btsugs/ 'dul ba dang /dbu ma/ phar phyin/ mngon pa/ blo sbyong gi skor sogs la 'chad nyan rgya cher mdzad/ mkhas grub kyi slob bu mang du byung / mdor na 'khor gdong dang g.yu khog bshad grwa'i mkhan po mdzad de mi lo bcu'i ring la chos 'chad nyan dang sgom sgrub kyis sgo nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don kho na mdzad de bzhugs so//89

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjod dang ga su nga rtsom / 2 dus 'gyur gyi skabs/rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa phag (spyi lo 1959)lor g.yu khog yul nas sngon thon pa rnams kyis bzung ste rta'u rdzong btson khang la bcugabardung brdeg gi tshor ba'ang rgya cher myong dgos pa byung yod/ btson grogs rnams kyis bu dang chung ma/ nor dang longs spyod/ thob dang go sa sogs bral ba'i rkyen gyis sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa myong bzhin yod pa la/ khong gis snying rje tshad med par skyes nas nyam thag gi btson grogs la 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ 'dus byas mi rtag pa/thar ba'i phan yon/ las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam bzhag bde sdug thams cad rang gi sems la thug yod tshul sogs kyi gdams ngag mang du bstan pas/ btson grogs rnams la phan pa phran bu byung gsungs/skabs der mkhan rin po ches dkon mchog gsum dang yi dam gyi lha rje btsun sgrol ma la gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab nas bzhugs/ nub gcig rmi lam 'od gsal du brag dkar po dbyibs snying dang 'dra ba zhig gi phyogs thams cad lta na sdug pa nyams dga' ba'i spang ljongs dang me tog sna tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dbas su rje btsun sgrol ma sku ༄mdog sngo ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhig mjal/ mos gus tshad med pa'i sgo nas gsol ba yang yang btab pas/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i phyag g.yon gyis phyag rgya mdzad pa'i srin mdzub kyi rtser tai yig cig 90

mkhan chen thub bstan chos kyi grags pa 'i rnam tha ra snying ba sdu sa / bzhugs pa mjal/ de nas skad cig gis lta yig de nyid saṃ grangs bdun pa zhig tu gyur/ ang grangs bdun pa de'ang gnas 'gyur nas yi ge sho lo ka gcig gi gzugs su shar pa ni 'di ltar/ sprel lo sprel zla shar ba'i tshe/ /bstan pa 'phel ba'i mgo tshugs nas/ /bgrang bya phrag gnyis brgyad 'das pa/ /bstan pa'i me ro gzhung nas ldang / /zhes rje btsun sgrol mas lung bstan to/ /rta'u btson khang nang lo hril po gcig bzhugs dgos pa byung / khong ni dar mdo rdzong gi mi yin pas rta'u rdzong gis dar mdo rdzong la sprad/ dar mdo rdzong gis nyin 'ga' zhig la btson du bcug te brdung rdeg phran bu byas nas pha yul la mngags/ de nas mkhan rin ches rje btsun sgrol ma gsol ba 'debs bzhin zhabs kyi 'khor lo bskor te pha yul lha sgang gi phyogs su bgrod pa'i lam bar du pha yul gyi rdal pa rnams dang 'phrad/mkhan rin po ches rten 'brel zhig brtags skabs/ rdal pa tsho'i ja khol nas 'thung chas byed bzhin pa dang khel bas rten 'brel legs por brtsis/ de nas gsol ja zhig bzhes te rdal pa rnams dang 'grogs nas pha yul la 'byor/ pha yul nas mi lo bcu phrag lhag gi ring la zhing srang dang / rtswa srang / chu 'khor g.yog pa sogs mnyam ra ra las khang gi las ka sna mang la zhugs dgos pa byung / de yi ring la chos 'chad nyan byed pa'i go skabs ni gtan nas ma rnyed mod/ 'on kyang zhing srung sogs kyi skabs su lkog nas sgom sgrub dang / dpe 91

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / gzigs/ bstan bcos rtsom pa'i go skabs mi dman pa thob yod/dper na skabs der nyin re la phyag lnga stong phul ba dang / 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i 'grel chen dang / yum ka 'grel pa sogs mdzad/ dgon shul rnams su dpe cha 'tshol bsdu la byon/ seng ge dgon sogs nas dpe cha 'ga' tsam re rnyed/ dpe cha rnams blo 'khel pa'i khyim tshang rnams la bcol ba dang / sa khung sogs su sbas nas bzhag nam dgos dus su blangs nas dpe gzigs gnang ba/ tshad ma rig rgyan sogs dpe cha 'ga' zhig phyi khung zhig gi nang du sbas yod pa de nyin gcig len sar byon skabs dpe cha rnams rul skyon thebs nas gzigs thabs med pa gyur yod pas/ mkhan rin po che yun ring du bshum nas phyir phebs/ yang nyin gcig rtswa phung zhig gi rgyab na dbu ma 'jug pa dpe gzigs mdzad bzhin bzhugs skabs sa gnas kyi 'go khrid rnams glo bur thog tu slebs/ khong gis de ma thag tu dbu ma 'jug pa de rtswa phung nang du 'phangs/ de nas rtswa phung la rgyab gtad de bzhugs/ kho tshos mkhan rin po che la rtswa legs por mi srung ba ci byed kyin yod zer nas gshe gshe 'ga' btang ste phyir log kho tshos dbu ma 'jug pa ma mthong pa de ni rje btsun sgrol ma'i thugs rje yin gsungs/skabs der mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma rin po che yang lha sgang na bzhugs yod pas/ mchog sprul rin po che lkog nas mkhan rin po che'i mdun du mngon pa dang / phar phyin/ dbu ma sogs mdo sngags kyi 92

mkhan chen thub bstan chos kyi grags pa 'i rnam tha ra snying ba sdu sa / chos du ma'i dka' gnad rnams la sgro gleng gnang sar yang yang phebs/phyis su mchog sprul thab bstan nyi ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ deng ༄skabs bod gangs can gyi ljongs na nang don rig pa la khong 'dra ba'i mkhas pa med/ ma zad khong ni 'jig rten chos brgyad dang bral pa'i chos pa rnam dag yin gsungs nas bstod bsngags yang yang mdzad/mkhan rin po ches kyang mchog sprul rin po che ni rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i sprul sku dngos yin pas/ sangs rgyas mngon sum yin/khong la zhabs phyi phran bu re 'byor na thar ba'i lam sna zin pa gdon mi za gsungs nas/ sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes 'jog la/ ma zad mchog sprul rin po che la rgyun du zhabs brtan dang sku rim 'bul/3 sman par bskos pa'i skabs/rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu bya (spyi lo 1972)lor khong nang skor sde ba'i sman par bskos/ thub chos dang / seng dga'/ tsha bo pad blo sogs sman phrug bcu phrag lhag la gso rig gi gzhung dang lag len dmar khrid gnang / phyogs med kyi nad pa mang du byung / chu nad can sogs nad pa tshabs chen du ma'i srog gi 'jigs pa las grol bar mdzad/ sman pa gnang chog pa'i go skabs rnyed pa nas sa gnas kyi dpon po rnams kyis khong la bla grwa gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i gu yangs ci nus byas/ de nas sman la kha g.yar te lkog tu slob bu bkra shis don 93

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtsom / 'grub dang / rig 'dzin/ kun pa sogs la gzhan dga'i spyod 'jug mchan 'grel dang / mi nyag kun bzang bsod nams kyi spyod 'jug 'grel chen/ rgyal sras lag len gyi 'grel pa/ sher le'u spyi don/dpal sprul gyi khrid yig kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung / 'jam dbyangs blo gter dbang po'i mngon pa'i mchan 'grel sogs chos mang du gsungs/ de nas bzung khong gis chos 'chad nyan gyi sgo nas gdul bya skyong ba'i go skabs slar yang thob pa yin no//4 nang skor mdor chos sgar btab pa'i skabs/rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags sprel (spyi lo 1980)lor chos lugs srid jus cung zad lhod pas/ phyogs so so nas slob ma mang du 'dus/ de rnams la dge tshul slong gi sdom pa gnang / gso sbyong dang tshes bcu rgyun tshogs mdzad/ slob ba rnams kyi blo rim ltar nyi ma re la ༄chos khrid gsum bzhi gsungs/ nang skor mdor chos sgar btab nas bzhugs/ de nas bar skabs brag mkhar ri khrod dang / rdo zam ri khrod sogs su chos sgar btab ste mdo sngags kyi chos la 'chad nyan rgyun mi chad par mdzad nas bzhugs/ mdor na khong gis smad mi nyag gi phyogs su sangs rgyas bstan pa dar spel dang nyams gso bla na med pa gnang yod pas/ spyir bod gangs can dang bye brag mi nyag dang rgyal 94

mkhan chen thub bstan chos kyi grags pa'i rnam tha ra snying ba sdu sa / rong phyogs kyi yul la bka' drin shin tu che ba'o//5 dpal rin chen thang la gdan sa mdzad pa'i skabs/rab byung bcu bdun me yos (spyi lo 1987)lo'i dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad nyin dpon slob rnams kyis dung rgya gling dang bcas te bkra shis brgyad pa gsung bzhin lha sgang 'jam dbyangs ri'i g.yas zur dpal rin chen thang la phebs/ gnas de la sa 'dul mdzad/ gdan sa'i mthil la rtags btab/ bkra shis gso sbyong sogs 'tshogs te rten 'brel gyi mdzad sgo rgya cher spel/ skabs der bya zhig gi kha nas dar dkar po dri ma med pa zhig bzung ste/ nam mkha'i khams su 'phur lding gis dar dkar de gdan sa'i mthil la 'phangs/ de ltar rten 'brel dang mtshan ma legs por byung bas/ dge slob rnams ngo mtshar zhing thags rab tu dgyes/ lo de'i dgun gyi dus su gdan sa rin ༄chen thang la chos sgar btab ste 'chad nyan rgya cher mdzad/ dgun de'i zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer lnga'i mtshan mor mkhan rin po che la rmi lam 'od gsal gyi snang ba 'di lta bu zhig byung gsungs/ de'ang mdo khams smad kyi char mi nyag lha sgang gi dpal rin chen thang zhes bya bar/lha shing shug pa'i tshal gyi dbus su/ brag phug kha shar du bstan pa zhig gi nang / ri bong kha dog dung ltar dkar ba/ rna ba gnyis ring zhing rtse 95

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtsom / mor spu yi tshom bu re skyes pa/ zhal khyim dwangs la mdzes pa/ ri dwags phal ba las ring du 'phags pa/ de la khong ngo mtshar bas/ khyod su yin dris pas/ nga ni ri bong blo ldan shes rab yin zer/ khyed kyis 'di na ci byed kyin yod dris pas/ kho bo ni sngon byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la rtswa kun bzang zhig phul nas byang chub tu sems bskyed pa yin/ de'i bsod nams kyis snying stobs dang gzi mdangs lhag par che bas/ gcan gzan gtum po rnams kyis glags btsal yang ma rnyed/ yul 'di'i rang byung gi bdud rtsi'i chu mig dang / rtswa'i myu gu gang legs par longs spyod cing / byams pa dang gus pa la sogs pa'i yon tan khyad par can mnga' ba'i ri dwags kyi slob ba 'khor tshogs dang bcas ri dwags kyi rgyal po'i tshal dmi bye rigi byigyis yun du gnas pa yin/ kho bo la 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa'i rtags su mdog dung ltar dkar pa dang / shes rab mchog thob pa'i rtags su rna rtse ring zhing rno ba dang / bzod pa la gnas pa'i rtags su mig tho rangs kyi skar chen ltar gsal pa dang / tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i rtags su dri mas ma sbag pa dang / sems la g.yo sgyu med pa'i rtags su lus kyi spu ma 'dzangs pa dang / skye ba du ma sbyin pa'i stobs kyis lus rgyas shing mdzes pa dang / dge bcu mi ngom par spyad pas lus la 'od dang ldan pa dang / byang chub yan lag gi me tog bkram pas dri zhim dang ldan pa/ de bzhin bsam gtan dang brtson 'grub 96

mkhan chen thub bstan chos kyi grags pa 'i rnam thar snying bsdu sa/ sogs la yun du gnas pa'i rtags sogs mnga' tshul shin tu mang du gsungs/ de nas re zhig na rmi lam gyi snang tshul cung zad 'gya ba'i ༄mod la/ ri bong de mi snang bar gyur pa'i shul du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po/ de nyid gur gum gyi mdog lta bu'i mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/sku la ngur smrig gi na bza' gsol ba/ gzi byin gyi 'od dang bcas te/sngar ri bong 'dug sa'i phug pa chung ngu der byon nas/ rtswa'i gdan la zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs te/ bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon pa'i brda phyag g.yas pa sa gnon dang / thugs mnyam par ma bzhag pa mi mnga' ba'i brda phyag g.yon pa mnyam bzhag mdzad de/ dgyes pa'i mdangs dang bcas nga ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba yin no zhes lan gsum gsungs pa dang / rigs kyi bu khyod skye ba 'di'i 'og tu lam log pa dang lam dman par mi gtong /de nas rim gyis rigs bzang por skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes rmi lam gyi snang ba shin tu gsal po zhig byung gsungs/ de nas khong gi thugs sras bu chen mchog sprul rdo rje bkra shis dang mkhan po bkra shis don 'grub/ tsha bo pad blo sogs thugs sras bu slob rnams kyis gtan chags kyi bshad grwa zhig bzhengs rgyu'i gsol ba yang yang btab pas/mkhan rin po che'i zhal gyis bzhes te/ gdan sa 'dir bshad grwa dang / sgrub grwa gsar bzhengs mdzad/ de'ang bshad grwa'i gtsug lag khang gi 97

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtog sa ba rjo da dang ga su nga rtsom / 'og khang la ka ba so lnga dang steng khang la ka ba so lnga ste khyon ka ba bdun cu'i sa khyon yod pa dang / bshad grwa'i grwa shag dang / gnyer khang /gsol ston khang / sman khang bcas la ka ba bzhi brgya'i sa khyon dang ldan pa zhig bzhengs yod/ rtsig pa rnams rdo dras ma dang / nang gi bca' bkod thams cad shing / steng du rdza gyo sogs rgyu cha phun sum tshogs pa las grub pa/ gtsug lag khang gi phyogs bzhi na rgyal mtshan chen po bzhi dang / rtse mor gser tog gis brgyan pa/ /gtsug lag khang dang grwa shag gi dkyil du me tog sna tshogs dang spang ljongs las grub pa'i skyed mo'i tshal chen po bskrun/ skyed mo'i tshal de ni dpon slob rnams kyis chos kyi bsgro gleng mdzad pa'i 'dun sa dang / gsol ston bzhes sa/ spro gseng gnang yul gyi bste gnas chen por gyar yod/༄gtsug lag khang gi nang gi bkod pa ni 'og tshogs khang chen mo/ steng dpe mdzod khang dang / mgon khang / tshogs khang chung ba gnyis bcas bkod yod/ tshogs khang chen mo'i nang na gser zangs las grub pa'i mi tshad can gyi ston pa shākya thub pa'i sku dang / slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ rje blo bzang grags pa/ sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams dang / shing las grub pa'i mi tshad can gyi 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku dang / phyag na rdo rje/ sangs rgyas sman lha/ rje btsun mi la ras pa dang / gser dngul gyi pa tra dang rin po che sna 98

mkhan chen thub bstan chos kyi grags pa 'i rnam tha ra snying ba sdu sa / tshogs kyi phra can gyi mchod rten sku gdung cha brgyad bcas bzhugs/ /tshogs khang chen mo'i ldebs ris ni/ g.yas na mdzad pa bcu gnyis/bde chen zhing bkod/ rdor sems rigs lnga/ 'jam dbyangs rigs lnga/rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ smin gling bla brgyud/ sgra bsgyur mar pa'i lha tshogs/ g.yon phyogs na gdugs dkar lha tshogs/ sman lha mched brgyad/ zangs mdog dpal ri/ gnas brtan bcu drug sa skya'i gong ma rnam lnga/ klong chen snying thig gi bla brgyud/ rje yab sras gsum/mdun gyi g.yas phyogs na sgrol ma nyer gcig khro rgyal sme brtsegs lha tshogs/ snying thig gi bstan srung 'khor tshogs/ mdun gyi g.yon phyogs na rnam 'joms lha tshogs/ rnam sras rta brgyad/ phur bu'i lha tshogs dang / sgo khyams kyi gyang ldebs na rgyal chen sde bzhi/ srid pa'i 'khor lo/mngon pa'i lugs kyi 'jig rten chags tshul gyi dpe ris sogs bzhengs yod/ mgon khang nang na bal bo'i li khra'i sgrol ma'i sku dang /ston pa shākya thub pa'i sku dang / shing las grub pa'i sgrol ma nyer gcig gi sku sogs bzhugs/ khong gis grub mtha' ris med kyi slob ma skyong bzhin yod pas mgon blas sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi chog sku rim rnam gsum sogs gsung dgos pa las/ gsol ka'i skor mgon khang nang 'don mi chog pa'i srol mdzad/ mkhan rin po che'i slob ma su zhig yin yang bod kyi grub mtha' thams cad 'gal med ngo bo gcig tu 'dzin gyin yod/ grub mtha' ris med du 'dzin pa'i lta ba de ni 99

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtog sa brjod dang gsu nga rtsom / sangs rgyas kyi bstan dang gangs can gyi 'gro ba rnams la bzhag pa bla na med pa zhig yin pas kun gyis phyogs ris kyi 'khor lo ring du dor nas ris med kyi 'khor lo bskor na legs zhes nan tan gsangs/ /༄dpe mdzod khang na bka' 'gyur dang / bstan 'gyur/ snga 'gyur bka' ma sogs phyogs bsgrigs kyi skor dang / grub mthas ris med kyi gsung 'bum sna tshogs bcas po ti chig stong lhag bzhugs/ /gzhan yang mchod rdzas dang yo byad kyi skor ni/ gos sku sbyar ma'i thang ka cha nyi shu rtsa lnga/ sil snyan cha bzhi/ cha lang cha brgyad/ rgya gling cha gcig rag dung cha gnyis/ rkang gling cha gcig dung dkar cha gnyis/ mchod rnga cha gnyis/ kong chung cha nyis brgya/ bdun tshar cha bcu/ gdan ring cha bcu drug 'bol gdan cha bcu/ tshogs zangs cha gnyis/ gur che chung drug bcas spyod chas mang du yod do//6 sgrub grwa btab pa'i skor/rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa yos (spyi lo 1999)lor dpal rin chen thang gi g.yas zur la sgrub grwa bzhengs ba'i 'go brtsams/ lcags 'brug ( spyi lo 2000)lor phyi nang thams cad legs par grub/ sgrub grwa'i gtsug lag khang la ka ba drug gi sa khyon gnas/ nang rten gtso bo spyan ras gzigs kyi sku dang / rdo ka ma ru pa las grub pa'i ston pa shākya thub pa'i sku/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur sogs rten gsum mang du 100

mkhan chen thub bstan chos kyi grags pa 'i rnam tha ra snying ba sdu sa / bzhugs/ /sgrub khang bcu bzhi dang / gnyer khang gcig ja khang gcig bcas la ka ba nyer lnga'i sa khyon yod/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lags 'brag (spyi lo 2000)lo'i zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyer gnyis lha 65 ri'i bab dus chen gyi nyin der ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i dge tshul slong bcu gsum sgrub grwa la bzhugs/ de'ang mkhan rin po che'i zhal bkod ltar sgrub grwa ba rnams kyis lo gsum gyi ring la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kho na sgrub dgos so//7 'chad nyan gtso bo gang la mdzad pa'i skor/bshad grwa 'dis chos 'chad nyan gtso bo gang dang gang la mdzad tshul ni/ blo rim dang po pa rnams la mi nyag kun bsod kyi rgyal sras lag len gyi 'grel ba/ spyod 'jug 'grel chen/ mkhan po kun dpal gyi spyod 'jug 'grel ba/ gzhan dga'i spyod 'jug mchan 'grel/'phags pa klu sgrub kyi byis spring / 'ju mi pham gyi ka ri ka lnga bcu'i 'grel pa/ sher 'grel ke ta ka rgyal sras thogs med kyi spyod 'jug 'bru 'grel/ rdza dpal sprul gyi khrid yig kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung /gzhan yang blo rigs/ rtags rigs/ sum rtags dag gsum/ snyan ngag sogs khrid/ /blo rim gnyis pa pa rnams la 'ju mi pham gyi dbu ma rgyan gyi 'grel pa/ 'jam dbyangs blo gter dbang po'i dbu ma 'jug pa'i mchan 'grel/ 'ju mi pham gyi nges shes sgron me/ bod sprul gyi lta 101

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / grub shan 'byed/ 'ju mi pham pa'i brgal lan skor/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i 'grel pa/ go rams pa bsod nams seng ge'i dbu ma'i dka' gnad theg mchog gnad kyi zla zer/ lta ba ngan sel/ mi nyag kun bsod kyi dab ma'i spyi don sogs dab ma'i skor dang / 'ju mi pham gyi rig rami mkhas 'jug 'jam dbyangs blo gter dbang po'i mngon pa'i mchan 'grel/ mchims 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mngon pa mchims chen/ shākya mchog ldan gyi mngon pa'i mtha' dpyad sogs mngon pa'i skor dang /bod sprul gyi phar phyin 'grel pa/ 'jam dbyangs blo gter dbang po'i phar phyin mchan 'grel/ rgyal sras gzhan phan snang ba'i phar phyin mchan 'grel/ go rams pa'i sher phyin gyi spyi don sbas don zab mo gter gyi kha 'byed/ phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid sbas don rab gsal/phar phyin gyi dka' gnad yum don rab gsal/ dge 'dun nyi shu'i mtha' dpyad/ rten 'brel gyi mtha' dpyad/ bsam gzugs kyi mtha' dpyad/ mi nyag kun bsod kyi chos 'khor gyi mtha' dpyad/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i phar phyin gyi mtha' dpyad/ sog zlog blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi karma pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i dris lan sogs phar phyin gyi skor dang / 'ju mi pham gyi sor mdo'i mchan 'grel/ mi nyag kun bsod kyi 'dul ba gzhi bcu bdun gyi spyi don nor bu'i phreng ba/ yon dga'i sdom gsum mchan 'grel/ lo chen dharma shrī'i sdom gsum dpag bsam snye ma sogs 'dul ba'i skor/ paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyi tshad 102

mkhan chen thub bstan chos kyi grag sa pa 'i rnam tha ra snying ba sdu sa / ma rig rgyan sogs khrid/ /blo rim gsum pa ba rnams la bskyed rdzogs zin bris/ rgyal ba klong chen pa'i mdzod bdun/ snying thig ya bzhi'i dbang dang khrid/ sngags kyi spyi don tshangs dbyangs 'brug sgra/ gsang snying phyogs bcu mun sel/ dge rtse 'gyar med tshe dbang mchog grub kyi stogasang snying spyi don rol mtsho/ smin gling lo chen gyi gsang snying gi 'grel pa gsang bdag dgongs rgyan/ gsang snying gi spyi don gsang bdag zhal lung / karma gling pa'i bar do'i drug khrid/ zhabs dkar tshogs drug rang grol gyi lta ba mkha' lding gshog rlabs/ 'ju mi pham gyi tshig bdun rnam bshad/ dpal sprul gyi tshig gsum gnad brdegarig pa cer mthong / smyo shul mkhan po lung rtogs kyi sems khrid zin bris sogs khrid do//8 sdom pa gsum gyi rgyun spel tshul gyi skor/byang chub sems dang zab mo sngags kyi sdom pa ni bla sprul dang grwa ser/ mi skya pho mo grangs las 'das pa la gnang yod/ so thar gyi sdom pa ni dge slong nyis brgya dang / dge tshul nyis stong / tshangs spyod dge bsnyen chig stong lhag gnang / /bod du dar ba'i 'dul ba'i sdom rgyun la rtsa ba'i sgo nas dbye na gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i lugs kho na dang / gang zag gi sgo nas dbye na mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho nas brgyud pa la snga 'gyur gyi sdom rgyun nam smad 'dul zhes grags pa dang / stod 103

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs ba rjo da dang ga su nga rtsom / mnga' ris phyogs su paṇ+ḍi ta dharma pā la sogs pā la rnam gsum nas brgyud pa la stod 'dul zhes pa dang / kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī nas brgyud pa la kha che'i lugs zhes pa dang sdom rgyun mi 'dra ba gsum bzhugs pa las/ mkhan rin po che'i sdom rgyun ni mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho'i sdom rgyun smad 'dul yin no//9 dgon sde ris med nas slob ma byung tshul gyi skor/dkar mdzes rang skyong sa khul nas mi nyag brag mkhar dgon pa/seng ge dgon pa/ ra lu gsham nang dgon pa/ skyid snang dgon pa/lcam glag dgon pa/ bā+oḥganas dgon pa/ lha sgang dgon pa/ sku nub dgon pa/ bka' bzhi dgon pa/ lha 'bri dgon pa/ phyug mo dgon pa/gangs dkar dgon pa/ khams gsum brag dgon pa/ ri khud dgon pa/mgo btags ra ti dgon pa/ mgar thar dgon pa/ g.yu khog dgon pa/ 'khor gdong dgon pa/ rdzogs chen dgon pa/ glag brag rdzong dgon pa/ ma hā skyid lung dgon pa/ phag mo ri dgon pa/ li thang mi 'gyur dgon pa/ dar mdo rdo rje brag dgon pa/ lnga mchod dgon pa/dung dkar dgon pa/ brag steng dgon pa/ rag shul 'ug lung dgon pa/ rong pa tsha ba'i ban rgan dgon pa/ yid lhung g.yag ze dgon pa/rnga ba rang skyong khul nas khog tha sang sang dgon pa/ rdzas tha gnam mtsho dgon pa/ mdo chen a kho ri'i dgon pa/ 'jo ro dgon pa/ rgyal 104

mkhan chen thub bstan chos kyi grags pa 'i rnam tha ra snying ba sdu sa / rong mtshams gnas dgon pa/ rgyal rong chos gling dgon pa/ gzigs spro dgon pa/ yun nan zhing chen gyi sa khul nas/ li chu rdzong gi sgra snyan dgon/ mu li rang skyong rdzong nas/ mu li dgon chen/ mtsho sngon phyogs nas/ mgo log lung sngon dgon pa/ 'ba' dgu rong dgon pa/ shing khri dgon pa sogs so//1༷ mkhan po'i mtshan gsol ba'i skor/mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po dngos kyis mtshan gsol ba'i mkhan po'i go sa 'dzin pa ni/ mchog sprul rdo rje bkra shis dang / li thang bsod nams rgya mtsho/ mi nyag seng ge dgon pa'i bkra shis don 'grub dang / blo bzang rgya mtsho/ mdo sngags/ mi nyag brag mkhar dgon pa'i sprul sku 'brag grags rgya mtsho dang / thub bstan snyan grags/ blo ri bca ///redaga'/ rgyal rong mtshams gnas dgon pa sangs rgyas thar dang /'jam dpal/ thar 'bum/ 'gyur med/ tshe ring don 'grub/ kun bzang / dri med/ lha 'bum/ khog tha sang sang dgon pa'i snyan grags bzang po/ mtsho sngon dgu rong dgon pa'i shes rab rgya mtsho/ mgo log lung sngon dgon pa'i pad+ma byang chub/ li thang bsod nams chos 'phel/dung dkar dgon pa'i tshe ring bkra shis sogs te khyon sum cu lhag byung yod la/ /gzhan yang mkhan rin po ches dngos su mkhan po'i mtshan ma gnang yang chos 'chad nyan byed nus pa'i slob ma mang du 105

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / byung yod do//bdun pa/ dgon sde dang slob grwa rnams su phebs nas bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul/1 khog tha sang sang dgon du byon pa'i skor/rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing rta (spyi lo 1954lor bla ma tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyis sang sang dgon du spyan drangs/ khong gis thog mar grwa ser dang / mi skya pho mo yongs la skyabs 'gro dang / sems bskyed kyi sdom pa gnang / las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam bzhag dang / dge ba bcu'i chos gsungs/ badz+ra gu ru dang / ma ṇi sogs 'tshogs/ /de nas sgrub gnas rta shar ri khrod du phebs te thugs mtshams su nyin bdun phrag gnyis la bzhugs skabs der mkhan rin po che'i zhal nas/'jol mo sogs bya rigs rnams kyis khong la chos kyi brda skad mi 'dra ba sna tshogs bstan gsungs/ ma zad gnas de'i seṅge brag ces pa'i ngos su phyag mdzub kyis a yig zhig bris pas a yig de deng skabs dngos sa mjal rgyu yod/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i me sprel (spyi lo ༄1956)lor sde dgon gyi re ba ltar slar yang sang sang dgon du byon/grwa ser rnams la dge tshul slong gi sdom pa gnang / ka ri ka dang /sdom gsum gsungs/ mi skya pho mo rnams la dge ba bcu sogs chos 106

mkhan chen thub bstan chos kyi grags pa'i rnam tha ra snying ba sdu sa / mang du bstan to/ /de nas mgo dgu ya thang gi gnas su zhag bdun phrag 'ga' la thugs mtshams bzhugs/ skabs der gnas ri de nas ka yig rang byung zhig gter nas bton to//skabs de ni dus kyi zing 'khrug la nye ba'i mtshams su khel yod pas/bstan pa dar rgud sogs dus 'gyar gyi lung bstan mang du gsungs/༄dus bzang ngan ji ltar byung yang las rgyu 'bras mig gi 'bras bu bzhin srung dgos/ dkon mchog gsum gtan nas brjed mi nyan pa sogs kyi zhal gdams mang du gnang / bla ser dang / mi skya pho mo yongs la skyabs 'gro dang / sems bskyed kyi sdom pa gnang / tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba'o//spyi lo 1958lo nas 1978lo'i bar gyi mi lo nyi shu'i ring la mkhan rin po che'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mjal ba dang / gsung gi bdud rtsi la rol ba'i skal pa ma byung / phyis su dus tshod cung zad lhod skabs nag bran pa'i dge legs rgya mtsho'i ngag rgyun las mkhan rin po che mi nyag phyogs na bde bar bzhugs pa'i gtam phyogs tsam go bas/de ma thag tu bla ma tshe dbang rig 'dzin sogs grwa rgan 'gas lkog tu gros mdzad de 'tshol du mi gcig mi nyag phyogs su brdzangs/ khos mkhan rin po che dngos su mjal zhing / gtam bzang de khyer nas myur du phyir 'byor/ de nas yul dgon gyi ser skya rnams zhal mjal dang chos gsan sar rgyun du bskyod pa'i skal ba thob bo//107

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags bya (spyi lo 1981)lor bla ma lha dbang zla ba sogs yul dgon gnyis kyi re gsol ltar sang sang dgon du phebs/ sang sang dgon nas khrid yig kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung /blo ldog rnam bzhi sogs gsungs/ khog tha dang rdzas tha gnyis gtsos sde khag brgyad dgu tsam la lhan du g.yang sgrub dang / bum sgrub/ tshogs 'khor/ bsang gsol sogs rgya cher 'tshogs/ yul lha dang gzhi bdags bcud nyams pa rnams gsos/ grwa rigs rnams la dge tshul slong gi sdom pa dang / mi skya pho mo rnams la skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed kyi sdom pa gnang / dge bcu'i chos gsungs/ rgan rabs rnams la 'pho ba sogs gsungs te dad ldan mang tshogs kun gyi re ba bskangs nus par mdzad do//rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu sprel (spyi lo 1992)lor slar yang sang sang dgon du phebs/ ser skya pho mo yongs la smyung gnas kyi sdom pa gnang / ser skya kun gyis mnyam du lo ltar smyung gnas cha brgyad bsrang pa'i srol btod/ phyis sa bla ma'i bka' bzhin lo ltar 'tshogs/rimi mi risisko phyag rdzas dang sgor mo mang du gnang nas sang sang dgon pa nyams gso byed du bcug dbyar gnas gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ mkhan bkra shis don 'grub dbyar gnas mkhan por mngags pas sdom gsum dang / mi nyag kun bsod kyi spyod 'jug 'grel chen/ khrid yig kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung sogs gsungs/108

mkhan chen thub bstan chos kyi grags pa 'i rnam tha ra snying ba sdu sa / rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me glang (spyi lo 1997)lor slar yang sang sang dgon du byon/ dgon pa la rab gnas mdzad/ g.yang bum dang / klu bum sogs bsgrubs/ ser skya pho mo rnams la byang sdom dang /las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam bzhag sogs chos mang du gsungs/ bka' 'gyar tshar gcig dang / rten gsum du ma/ mkhan rang nyid kyi phyag ༄dpe rnams dang / na bza' cha tshang gcig bcas dgon pa la gnang /gzhan yang phyogs 'dir byon skabs rdzas tha dgon pa/ mdo chen a kho ri'i dgon pa/ ja kha'i dgon pa/ 'jo ro zur dgon pa/ ka khang rdo dga' dgon sogs rnga ba khul gyi dgon sde du mar zhabs kyis bcags te dbyar gnas nyams gso dang gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ dgon pa nyams gso'i ched du nor rdzas dang sgor mo gnang ba dang / thugs blo phud pa/ dge tshul slong gi sdom pa gnang / mi skya pho mo rnams la skyabs 'gro dang / sems bskyed kyi sdom pa gnang / dge sgrub sdig spang sogs chos mang du gsungs nas bstan 'gro'i don bla na med par mdzad/sang sang dgon du byon pa'i skor ni sang sang dgon pa'i mkhan po nam mkha' seng ge'i zhal snga nas bkod pa yin no//2 rgyal rong mtshams gnas dgon du byon pa'i skor/rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu khyi (spyi lo 1982)lor bla ma bstan rgyas kyis rgyal rong mtshams gnas (tshangs gnas)dgon du gdan drangs/109

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtog sa ba rjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / mkhan rin po ches mi skya pho mo rnams la skyabs 'gro dang / sems bskyed/ smyung gnas kyi sdom pa gnang / kun gyis lo ltar smyung gnas cha brgyad srung pa'i srol 'jog chang dang / du ba/ rngon/ rku rdzun sogs spyod ngan rnams byed mi chog pa'i dam bca' bzhag tu bcug yul sde de'i ra lug yod tshad tshe thar la btang / phyis su ra lug gcig kyang gsod mi chog par mdzad/ mi skya pho mo rnams chos lam du btsud/ khong gi zhal nas/ khyod tshos bshad grwa zhig bzheng nus na/ mkhas pa mang du 'byung zhing / yul 'dir bkra shis pa zhig 'byung nges zhes lung bstan/ mkhan po'i lung bstan ltar yul dgon gnyis kyis bshad grwa bzhengs bar khas blangs/ yang mkhan rin po che'i zhal nas/ khyod tsho'i skad ni bod kyi gna' skad yin la de'i steng nas chos 'chad nyan byed thabs med pas/ 'brog skad slob dgos gsungs nas/ byis pa rnams la 'brog skad bslab/ byis pa lnga bcu lhag grwa ba byed du bcugade dag la dge tshul gyi sdom pa gnang / spyod 'jug dang / sngon 'gro sogs gsungs/ de nas bshad grwa 'debs sa'i mthil la rtags btab/ sa 'dul mdzad/ skabs der khyod tshos rgyun du dam can mchod kyin yod mod/ 'on kyang khyod tsho'i srang ma ni lha mo red 'dug ༄gsungs nas/ lha srung mchod nor ba de yo bsrang mdzad/ bla ma chos 'bum gyis phul ba'i lha mo'i 'dra sku byin rlabs can de dgon pa'i rten gtso la gdan drangs/ rjes su lha mo'i gsol ka mchod dgos pa'i 110

mkhan chen thub bstan chos kyi grags pa 'i rnam tha ra snying ba sdu sa / srol btod/ phyir mi nyag lha sgang tu phebs skabs mtshams gnas dgon pa'i grwa phrug lnga bcu lhag 'brog skad dang dpe cha sbyang sar khrid/de nas nags lung ma dang / nang skor sde/ ra lu sde sogs kyi khyim tshang bzang shos re la grwa phrug re bcol nas 'brog skad slob sbyong byed du bcug khong gi thags rje las grwa phrag rnams kyis lo phyed kyi ring la no༅ raba'abrog skad brda 'phrod pa tsam shes shing / mkhan rin po ches khong tsho la 'brog skad kyi rgyug blangs/ de nas ri ka lnga bcu pa dang / spyod 'jug sogs chos mang du gsungs/rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing bya (spyi lo 1984lor slar yang rgyal rong mtshams gnas dgon du byon/ sngar gyi grwa phrug lnga bcu po phyir tshangs gnas dgon du khrid/ bshad grwa dang dbyar gnas btsugs/ ṣ+ṭha0tshams gnas7shad grwa'i nang ston pa thugs rje can dang gnas brtan bcu drug gu ru mtshams brgyad kyi sku gsar du bzhengs/ dgon pa'i nang sgrol ma'i sku byin rlabs can zhig yod pa de bshad grwa'i nang spyan drangs/ bshad grwa ba rnams kyis rgyun du sgrol ma'i cho ga 'don dgos pa'i srol bzhag gzhan yang bshad grwa'i rgyun 'don 'jam dpal mtshan brjod dang / dbu ma/ phar phyin/ mngon pa/ spyod 'jug sdom gsum bcas kyi rtsa ba rnams dang / phar phyin gyi skabs brgyad dang don bdun cu'i mtshan nyid/ dge 'dun nyi shu dang / rnam mkhyen gyi bshad pa/ mngon pa las rgyu drug rkyen bzhi'i rnam bzhag spyod 'jug 111

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtog sa ba rjo da dang ga su nga rtsom / gi mtshan don sogs blo la len dgos pa'i bka' phab/ bshad grwa pa rnams kyis rgyal rong gi skad gcig kyang bshad mi chog pa dang / khyim mi dang sbyin bdag rnams bshad grwa'i sgo chen brgal nas 'ong mi chog pa dang / grwa ba rnams kyi spyod pa 'dul ba dang lta ba theg chen gyi lugs bzhin mdzad dgos pa'i khrims bzhag mkhan bkra shis don 'grub mkhan por mngags/ mkhan bkra shis kyis bshad grwa dang dbyar gnas mkhan po mdzad de/ sdom gsum dang / spyod 'jug 'grel chen/ dab ma'i spyi don/ tshal khrims rnam dag gi mdo/ dkon rig ༄༄ mchog rjes dran/ dbu ma rgyan gyi 'grel pa/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i 'grel pa/ mngon pa mdzod 'grel/ phar phyin gyi 'grel pa sogs dpe khrid gnang nas lo bzhi'i ring la bzhugs so//rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa sbrul (spyi lo 1989)lor slar yang rgyal rong mtshams gnas dgon du phebs/ bshad grwa ba rnams la rgyug len mdzad/ sangs rgyas thar/ 'jam dpal/ 'gyur med/ thar 'bum rnams la phar phyin dang / dbu ma/ 'dul ba/ mngon pa'i mkhan po'i mtshan gsol/ phar phyin gyi mkhan po sangs rgyas thar bshad grwa'i mkhan po bskos/ gzhan dbu ma'i mkhan po 'jam dpal sogs dpe cha legs shos rnams zab sbyong du mkhan rang nyid kyi bshad grwa'i nang khrid/ /phyis su tshe ring don grub dang kun bzang / dri med/ lha 'bum/tshe brtan sogs mkhan po'i go sa 'dzin pa'i slob bu mang du byung /112

mkhan chen thub bstan chos kyi grags pa'i rnam tha ra snying ba sdu sa / deng skabs mkhan po de dag gi 'phrin las phyogs zhir rgyas bzhin bzhugs so/ /rgyal rong mtshams gnas (tshangs gnas)dgon du byon pa'i skor ni mkhan thar 'bum gyi zhal snga nas bkod pa yin no/ /3 si khron zhing chen bod yig slob grwar byon pa'i skor/rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu phag (spyi lo 1983)lor mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma rin po ches zhing chen bod yig slob grwar gdan drangs/mkhan rin po ches slob ma yongs la mi nyag kun bzang bsod nams kyi spyod 'jug 'grel chen dang / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i grub mtha' rin chen phreng ba'i dpe khrid mdzad/ gzhan yang zur zhugs pa'i slob ma mchog sprul rdo rje bkra shis dang / hor rong pa tsha ba'i bla ma bsod nams rgya mtsho/ mi nyag seng ge dgon pa'i mkhan po bkra shis don 'grub dang / blo bzang rgyal mtshan sogs la mngon pa mchims chen gsangs/ zhing chen bod yig slob grwa nas slob dus gcig gi yun ༄la bzhugs/ dge slob rnams kyis rgyun du bod yig slob grwar bzhugs rgyu'i gsol ba yang yang btab pas bzhugs rgyu'i thugs 'dun yod mod/ 'on kyang si khron zhing chen bod brgyud nang bstan slob grwar mkhan por byon rgyu khas blangs zin pas slob dus gcig las bzhugs pa'i dus skabs ma byung ba'o// 113

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtog sa brjo da dang ga su nga rtso ma / 4si khron zhing chen bod brgyud nang bstan slob grwar byon pa'i skor/rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing byi (spyi lo 1984lor mchog sprul shes rab 'od zer gyis si khron zhing chen bod brgyud nang bstan slob grwar gdan drangs/ mkhan rin po che nas/ dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul dang / rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul/ yun nan bde chen bod rigs rang skyong khul/ ma li bod rigs rang skyong rdzong bcas ༄nas phebs pa'i bla sprul rnams dang / mkhan rin po che rang nyid kyi chos sgar gyi slob ma rnams dang lhan gcig tu 'tshogs/ de dag la dbu ma'i skor dang / mngon pa'i skor/ phar phyin gyi skor/ tshad ma'i skor/ 'dul ba'i skor/ gsang sngags kyi skor sogs chos rgya cher gsungs nas mi lo lnga'i ring la slob grwa der bzhugs so/ /bod brgyud nang bstan slob grwa 'di thog mar mi nyag lha sgang gi yul du btsugs/phyis su dkar mdzes yul du gnas spos/ mkhan rin po che slar yang slob grwas gdan zhus ltar thengs gcig phebs nas dge slob rnams la zab rgyas kyi chos mang du gsungs so//5 nyag rong rdzong glag brag rdzong dgon du byon pa'i skor/rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing glang (spyi lo 1985)lor ber gtsang 114

mkhan chen thub bstan chos kyi grags pa 'i rnam tha ra snying ba sdu sa / sprul sku 'od gsal dang / rtswa ra bla ma sangs rgyas kyis glag brag rdzong dgon du gdan drangs/ mkhan rin po che nas ser skya pho mo yongs la skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed kyi sdom pa gnang / rgan rabs rnams la 'pho ba'i khrid mdzad/ bshad grwa btsugs/ bshad grwa ba rnams la ka ri ka lnga bcu sogs chos mang du gsungs/ mo the bla ma tshe ring dpal ldan la mkhan po'i mtshan gsol nas bshad grwa'i mkhan por bskos/bstan 'gro'i don mdzad nas gnas der nyin bco lnga tsam bzhugs/glag brag rdzong dgon du byon pa'i skor ni brag rdzong dgon pa'i dab ༄mdzad bla ma sangs rgyas kyi zhal snga nas bkod pa yin no//6 rdzogs chen thri seng bshad grwar byon pa'i skor/rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa 'brug (spyi lo 1988)lor rdzogs chen mchog sprul pad+ma skal bzang gis rdzogs chen shrī seng chos grwar gdan drangs/ mkhan rin po ches 'dus sde rgya mtsho lta bu'i dge slob yongs la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dka' ba'i gnas dge 'dun nyi shu'i bshad khrid zab rgyas gnang / dge slob rnams kyi yid tshims te bstod bsngags kyi me tog yang yang gtor/ ma zad shrī seng nas gtan bzhugs mdzad rgyu'i gsol ba lan mang btab par/mkhan rin po che la yang bzhugs 'dod shin tu che mod/ 'on kyang mi nyag na bshad grwa skyong bzhin yod pas bzhugs thabs gang yang ma byung /115

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjod dang gsung rtsom/ skabs der bstan srung tsi dmar kyis grwa gzugs bstan nas mkhan rin po che'i rjes su rdzogs chen bar du phebs pa dpon slob kun gyis mthong / spyir tsi dmar ni khong la rang 'khor du bzhugs yod pa bu slob mang pos mthong yod do//7 pe cin bod brgyud nang bstan slob grwar byon pa'i skor/rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa sbrul (spyi lo1989)lor pe cin bod brgyud nang bstan slob grwas pe cin du gdan drangs/ mkhan rin po che nas/ bod ljongs dang / si khron/ mtsho sngon/ yun nan/ kan su'u sogs ljongs bcas nas phebs pa'i bla sprul rnams la mkhan chen khro ru tshe rnam gyis mdzad pa'i snga 'gyur rnying ma'i grub mtha' sogs la bshad khrid zhib rgyas gnang / bla sprul rnams thugs mnyes nas bstod bsngags kyi me tog yang yang gtor/ slob grwa'i dge slob yongs dang rgya yi dge bsnyen rnams la sangs rgyas sman lha'i dbang dang / tshe dbang sogs bskur nas zla ba gsum la bzhugs/ skabs der rgya yi dge bsnyen rnams kyis kyang mkhan rin po che ni sangs rgyas sman lha'i sku dngos yin pa dang / dbang rdzas kyi steng na sman lha'i sku rang byung yod pa sogs mthong bas/ sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag cing /bod kyi chos dang bod kyi bla sprul rnams la sngar las lhag pa'i dad pa je cher gyar pa byung ba'o/ /phyis su pe cin bod brgyud nang bstan slob grwa sto116

mkhan chen thub bstan chos kyi grags pa 'i rnam tha ra snying ba sdu sa / nas gdan zhu thengs gnyis tsam byung yang / sku na bgres pa dang phyag las mang ba'i rkyen gyis byon pa'i thugs skabs ma byung ba'o//8 li thang mi 'gyur dgon du byon pa'i skor/rab byung bcu bdun pa'i shing 'brug (spyi lo 1994lor mkhan rin po che mchog gi thugs sras bsod nams rgya mtshos li thang mi 'gyur dgon du gdan drangs te/ ser skya pho mo yongs la skyabs 'gro dang / sems bskyed kyi sdom pa gnang / las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam bzhag dang / dge ba bcu'i chos dang / 'pho ba sogs chos mang du gsungs/ser skya yongs la 'pho ba'i rtags khyad par can byung ba/ gter bum bsgrubs nas yul sde'i sa bcud nyams pa rnams gsos/ mi 'gyur dgon du sa skya'i bshad grwa zhig btab/ slob ma bsod nams rgya mtsho bshad grwa'i mkhan por bskos/ deng skabs bshad grwa der rgyun bzhugs kyi slob ma brgya dang lnga bcu lhag yod/ gzhan dgon sde rnams su phebs nas dgon pa nyams gso dang / dbyar gnas dang bshad grwa btsugs pa/ dgon sde so so la mkhan po mngags pa/ mang tshogs la chos gsungs pa sogs bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul bsam gyis mi khyab par brjod rgyu yod do// mi 'gyar dgon du byon pa'i skor ni stomakhan bsod nams chol 'phel gyi zhal snga nas bkod pa yin no//117

mkhan chen chos kyi grags pa'i rtog sa ba rjo da dang ga su nga rtsom / brgyad pa/ sgrub pa nyams len dang 'dus byas kyi dge rtsa rgya cher bsags pa'i skor/khong gi sku tshe hril po la gdul bya skyong bzhin sgrub pa nyams len kho na mdzad nas bzhugs/ slob bu rnams dang dad ldan pho mo rnams kyis snang tshul la khong la 'dod chags dang zhe sdang ni gtan nas med pa lta bu zhig mthong bzhin yod/ dus 'gyar gyi skabs su bla ser rnams ༄la 'pho 'gyur sna tshogs byung mod/ 'on kyang mkhan rin po che khong ni me tog pad+ma 'dam las skyes kyang 'dam gyi dri mas ma gos pa bzhin du bzhugs pa la/ skye dgu'i 'gro ba rnams ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su gyur te bstod bsngags kyi me tog nam yang 'gog pa med pa phyogs kun tu gtor zhing bkram pa/ nga rang sngon khong gi mdun na chos zhus nas yod skabs rgyun du nye gnas tsha bo pad blo la bka' bkyon 'dra ba gnang bzhin yod/ nyin gcig dgong 'tshogs skabs mkhan pos zhal nas de ring nga pad blo'i steng la dngos su khong khro skyes shor song bshags pa gsungs rogs gsungs nas yig brgya mang du gsungs so/ /mkhan rin po che'i zhal nas/ slob bu mdo sde mgon po la nyams len la nan tan mdzod dang nam mkhar 'phur ba dang / sa 'og tu 'dzul ba sogs grub rtags rdzig po med kyang nyon mongs ni zad nges red ces nyams myong gi zhal gdams gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i rnam thar ni 118
